muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿وأما الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات﴾: conjoined to the previous verse; الصالحات is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿فيوفيهم أجورهم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of أما; يوفيهم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the hāʾ is the first direct object, and أجورهم is the second direct object; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of الذين.
﴿والله لا يحب الظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا يحب الظالمين﴾ is the khabar. The clause ﴿والله لا يحب الظالمين﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿ذلك نتلوه عليك من الآيات﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; ذلك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause نتلوه is the khabar (predicate), and عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); or: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ, the clause ﴿نتلوه﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, and من الآيات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿والذكر الحكيم﴾: conjoined to الآيات, and الحكيم is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿إن مثل عيسى عند الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿مثل﴾ is its noun, عيسى is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and عند الله is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿كمثل آدم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿مَثَل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and آدم is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote.
﴿خلقه من تراب﴾: خلقه: a verb and its direct object, and the agent is "he", referring to Allah. من تراب: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خلقه﴾. The clause ﴿خلقه من تراب﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position, or it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from Ādam, peace be upon him, with ﴿قد﴾ implied.
﴿ثم قال له كن فيكون﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; قال is a past verb; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قال; the clause ﴿كن﴾, the complete (tāmma) verb, is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); and his words فيكون are conjoined, and it is the narration of a past state (ḥikāyat ḥāl māḍiya).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿الحق من ربك﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; الحق is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and من ربك is the khabar (predicate). It is also said: الحق is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "what We have related to you is the truth", and من ربك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلا تكن من الممترين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you know this, and you do know it, then do not be"; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition, with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive; تكن is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you"; and من الممترين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:145-145.t:
﴿وما كان لنفس أن تموت إلا بإذن الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿لنفس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿كان﴾; ﴿أن تموت﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what is in its scope is its postponed noun (ism); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿بإذن الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); it is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh) from the most general of states, the implied sense being: "and it was not for it to die except being permitted [to do so]."
﴿كتابا مؤجلا﴾: ﴿كتابًا﴾ is a maṣdar, accusative (manṣūb) as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) conveying emphasis of the content of the clause before it; ﴿مؤجلًا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ومن يرد ثواب الدنيا نؤته منها﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾ is conditional, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يرد﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿ثواب الدنيا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿نؤته﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its being jussive (majzūm) being the dropping of the weak letter, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نؤته﴾.
﴿ومن يرد ثواب الآخرة نؤته منها﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to the one before it.
﴿وسنجزي الشاكرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿سنجزي﴾ is a nominative imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "We" (naḥnu); ﴿الشاكرين﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿فمن حاجك فيه﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); حاجك is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) حاجك, and the pronoun refers to ʿĪsā or to the truth in general. The clause ﴿فمن حاجك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿من بعد ما جاءك من العلم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to حاجك, i.e. from that time; ما is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause جاءك is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and من العلم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being of knowledge".
﴿فقل تعالوا ندع أبناءنا وأبناءكم ونساءنا ونساءكم وأنفسنا وأنفسكم﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; قل is an imperative verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you"; تعالوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the clause قل is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the conditional noun in this verse is من, not ما]; the clause تعالوا is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); ندع is an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the response to a request, and its agent is "we"; أبناءنا is a direct object, and أبناءكم and what follows it are conjoined to his words ﴿أبناءنا﴾.
﴿ثم نبتهل فنجعل لعنة الله على الكاذبين﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay; نبتهل is an imperfect verb conjoined to ندع, jussive; the fāʾ is a conjunction for immediate succession; نجعل is conjoined to نبتهل; لعنة الله is a direct object; and على الكاذبين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نجعل, or in the position of an accusative, being in the place of the second object.

muyesser-irab:146-146.t:
﴿وكأين من نبي قاتل معه ربيون كثير﴾: كأين is predicative (khabariyya), in the meaning of the predicative kam, and it is in the position of a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject); من نبي is the tamyīz (specification) of كأين;
the clause قاتل is the khabar (predicate) of كأين; معه is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; ربيون is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فما وهنوا لما أصابهم في سبيل الله﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ما is negating; وهنوا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); لما: the lām is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to وهنوا; the clause أصابهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; or ما is maṣdariyya, and the maṣdar (verbal noun) cast from ما and what is in its scope is genitive by the lām.
﴿وما ضعفوا وما استكانوا﴾: conjoined to ﴿ما وهنوا﴾.
﴿والله يحب الصابرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; the clause يحب الصابرين is the khabar; and the clause ﴿والله يحب الصابرين﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿إن هذا لهو القصص الحق﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle, ﴿هذا﴾ is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and القصص is the khabar (predicate); or: ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), القصص its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إن; الحق is an adjective (ṣifa) of القصص.
﴿وما من إله إلا الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating; من is a connective (ṣila) preposition; إله is genitive in form and a mubtadaʾ; or: the khabar is omitted, i.e. "for us". إلا is a particle of restriction, and the Name of Majesty is a badal (substitute) from the position of إله, which is the nominative. Or: the Name of Majesty is the khabar of إله. The clause ﴿وما من إله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن الله لهو العزيز الحكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām, هو is a pronoun of separation with no grammatical position, and العزيز is the khabar; or: ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, العزيز its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إن; الحكيم is an adjective of العزيز.

muyesser-irab:147-147.t:
﴿وما كان قولهم إلا أن قالوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the speech is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿قولهم﴾ is its fronted khabar (predicate), and its noun (ism) is the maṣdariyya أن and what is in its scope; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the exception is emptied (mufarragh) from the most general of things.
﴿ربنا اغفر لنا ذنوبنا وإسرافنا في أمرنا﴾: ﴿ربنا﴾ is a muḍāf (construct) munādā (one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; the clause ﴿اغفر﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اغفر﴾; ﴿ذنوبنا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وإسرافنا﴾ is conjoined to it; ﴿في أمرنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿إسرافنا﴾.
﴿وثبت أقدامنا وانصرنا على القوم الكافرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ثبت﴾ is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ); ﴿أقدامنا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وانصرنا﴾ is likewise conjoined; ﴿على القوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿انصرنا﴾; ﴿الكافرين﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:63-63.t: ﴿فإن تولوا فإن الله عليم بالمفسدين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; تولوا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). فإن: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ, إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, عليم is its khabar (predicate), and بالمفسدين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause ﴿فإن تولوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:148-148.t:
﴿فآتاهم الله ثواب الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, or resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿آتاهم﴾ is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); ﴿ثواب الدنيا﴾ is a second mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿فآتاهم الله...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وحسن ثواب الآخرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿حسن﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ثواب﴾.
﴿والله يحب المحسنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يحب المحسنين﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿والله يحب المحسنين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿قل يا أهل الكتاب﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb and its agent is "you"; يا is a vocative particle, and أهل الكتاب is a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct (muḍāf).
﴿تعالوا إلى كلمة سواء بيننا وبينكم﴾: the clause is accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); تعالوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إلى كلمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تعالوا; سواء is an adjective (ṣifa); بيننا is an adverb of place attached to سواء, because it has been treated like the maṣdars; and بينكم is conjoined to بيننا.
﴿ألا نعبد إلا الله﴾: أن is maṣdar-forming, لا is negating, and نعبد is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, whose agent is latent, its implied form being "we"; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what falls in its scope is a badal (substitute) from ﴿كلمة﴾, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "it is" (هي); إلا is a particle of restriction, and the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولا نشرك به شيئا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negating, نشرك is conjoined to نعبد, به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نشرك, and شيئًا is a direct object, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿ولا يتخذ بعضنا بعضا أربابا من دون الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negating, يتخذ is an imperfect verb conjoined to لا نعبد and لا نشرك, بعضنا is the agent, بعضًا is its first object, أربابًا is its second object, and من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿أربابًا﴾.
﴿فإن تولوا فقولوا اشهدوا بأنا مسلمون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and what follows it is a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تولوا is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); اشهدوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the clause is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl; ﴿بأنا﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, أن is an abrogating particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and مسلمون is its khabar; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar made genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿اشهدوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:149-149.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and ﴿أي﴾ is a munādā (one addressed) that is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), and hā is for alerting (tanbīh). الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾. ﴿آمنوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن تطيعوا الذين كفروا﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿تطيعوا﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and the whole clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يردوكم على أعقابكم﴾: ﴿يردوكم﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the wāw is the fāʿil, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿على أعقابكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فتنقلبوا خاسرين﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿تنقلبوا﴾ is an imperfect verb conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يردوكم﴾; ﴿خاسرين﴾ is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿يا أهل الكتاب لم تحاجون في إبراهيم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and أهل الكتاب is a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct; ﴿لم﴾: the lām is a preposition and ما is an interrogative noun whose alif was dropped after the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تحاجون; تحاجون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); في إبراهيم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تحاجون.
﴿وما أنزلت التوراة والإنجيل إلا من بعده﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; أنزلت is a past verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named); التوراة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and الإنجيل is conjoined to التوراة; إلا is a particle of restriction; من بعده is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزلت, so it is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh).
﴿أفلا تعقلون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of rebuke and wonder, and it enters upon an implied element which is what is conjoined to by this conjunction.

muyesser-irab:150-150.t:
﴿بل الله مولاكم﴾: ﴿بل﴾ is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿مولاكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate). The speech is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what is part of the content of the condition, and مولاكم is a badal (substitute) of it. [Translator's note: the last phrase is as written in the source; it is unclear what مولاكم would be a badal of, having just been parsed as the khabar.]
﴿وهو خير الناصرين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿خير الناصرين﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿ها أنتم هؤلاء حاججتم فيما لكم به علم﴾: ها is for alerting; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and هؤلاء is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause حاججتم is resumptive, with no grammatical position; فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) حاججتم; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and علم is a delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ما.
﴿فلم تحاجون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; لم: the lām is a preposition and ما is an interrogative noun whose alif was dropped after the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحاجون; تحاجون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فيما ليس لكم به علم﴾: فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تحاجون; ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ليس; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and علم is the delayed noun of ليس.
﴿والله يعلم وأنتم لا تعلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يعلم is the khabar; وأنتم: the wāw is a conjunction, and أنتم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause لا تعلمون is the khabar. The clause ﴿والله يعلم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:151-151.t:
﴿سنلقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; the sīn is a particle of futurity; ﴿نلقي﴾ is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "We" (naḥnu); ﴿في قلوب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نلقي﴾; ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿الرعب﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿بما أشركوا بالله ما لم ينزل به سلطانا﴾: ﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ together with what follows it is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نلقي﴾; or: ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, and the clause is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أشركوا﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the object of ﴿أشركوا﴾; the clause ﴿لم ينزل به سلطانًا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿سلطانًا﴾; ﴿سلطانًا﴾ is the object of ﴿ينزل﴾.
﴿ومأواهم النار﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿مأواهم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿النار﴾ is its khabar (predicate); or: مأواهم is a fronted khabar and النار a postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿وبئس مثوى الظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿بئس﴾ is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; ﴿مثوى﴾ is the fāʿil, in construct with [a noun] bearing ﴿ال﴾; ﴿الظالمين﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "the Fire"; and the clause ﴿وبئس مثوى الظالمين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:152-152.t:
﴿ولقد صدقكم الله وعده﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the lām is [in] the answer to an omitted oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿صدقكم الله﴾ is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent); ﴿وعده﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿إذ تحسونهم بإذنه﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صدقكم﴾; the clause ﴿تحسونهم﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the adverb's being put in construct with it; ﴿بإذنه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿تحسونهم﴾, i.e. "being permitted to you."
﴿حتى إذا فشلتم وتنازعتم في الأمر﴾: ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of terminus (ghāya) and a preposition in the meaning of "until" (ilā); or: حتى together with what it governs is attached to ﴿تحسونهم﴾, or attached to ﴿صدقكم﴾, i.e. "Allah fulfilled His promise to you until the time of your faltering"; or it is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), entering upon the conditional clause; ﴿إذا﴾ is an adverb of future time attached to its answer; the clause ﴿فشلتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by iḍāfa (genitive construct); the answer of ﴿إذا﴾ is omitted, the implied form being: "He withheld His help from you"; وتنازعتم: the wāw is conjunctive, and the clause ﴿تنازعتم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause ﴿فشلتم﴾; ﴿في الأمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تنازعتم﴾.
﴿وعصيتم من بعد ما أراكم ما تحبون﴾: conjoined to what preceded; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عصيتم﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿ما﴾ with the verb after it is genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it; ﴿أراكم﴾ is a past verb, its fāʿil being "he" (huwa), and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿تحبون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿منكم من يريد الدنيا ومنكم من يريد الآخرة﴾: ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿الدنيا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿منكم من يريد الدنيا﴾ is resumptive or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and on both views it has no grammatical position. ﴿ومنكم من يريد الآخرة﴾ is conjoined to the first clause.
﴿ثم صرفكم عنهم ليبتليكم﴾: ثم is a conjunction [denoting] delay (tarākhī); the clause ﴿صرفكم﴾ is conjoined to the omitted answer of إذا, i.e. "He withheld His help from you"; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿صرف﴾; ليبتليكم: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and ﴿يبتلي﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of causation; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to ﴿صرف﴾.
﴿ولقد عفا عنكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realization; عفا is a past verb; ﴿عنكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عفا﴾.
﴿والله ذو فضل على المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿ذو فضل﴾ is the khabar; ﴿على المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فضل﴾, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of it; and the clause ﴿والله ذو فضل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:153-153.t:
﴿إذ تصعدون ولا تلوون على أحد﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صرفكم﴾ or to ﴿عفا عنكم﴾; or it is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (udhkurū). The clause ﴿تصعدون﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct); ﴿ولا تلوون﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿تصعدون﴾; or: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿على أحد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تلوون﴾.
﴿والرسول يدعوكم في أخراكم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; الرسول is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يدعوكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿في أخراكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فأثابكم غما بغم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿أثابكم﴾ is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿غمًّا﴾ is a second mafʿūl bihi, by أثابكم being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of requiting and giving; or it is a tamyīz (specification); ﴿بغم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa), i.e. "grief joined to grief."
﴿لكيلا تحزنوا على ما فاتكم ولا ما أصابكم﴾: the lām is a preposition; كي is a particle of causation, of making accusative, and of futurity; ﴿لا﴾ is connective (ṣila); تحزنوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by ﴿كي﴾; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أثابكم﴾; ﴿على ما فاتكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحزنوا﴾; the clause ﴿فاتكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿ولا ما أصابكم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما فاتكم﴾.
﴿والله خبير بما تعملون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; خبير is the khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خبير﴾; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿والله خبير...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿ما كان إبراهيم يهوديا ولا نصرانيا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; إبراهيم is its noun and يهوديًّا its khabar (predicate); the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negating, and نصرانيًّا is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿يهوديًّا﴾.
﴿ولكن كان حنيفا مسلما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is lightened and inoperative (mukhaffafa muhmala); كان is a defective past verb; its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; حنيفًا is its first khabar and مسلمًا a second khabar.
﴿وما كان من المشركين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; من المشركين is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿إن أولى الناس بإبراهيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); أولى is its noun; الناس is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); بإبراهيم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولى; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿للذين اتبعوه﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); الذين is the khabar (predicate) of إن; اتبعوه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهذا النبي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [joining] to الذين, and النبي is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative.
﴿والذين آمنوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الذين is a relative noun conjoined to هذا النبي; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله ولي المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ولي is the khabar; and المؤمنين is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿والله ولي المؤمنين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿ودت طائفة من أهل الكتاب﴾: ودت is a past verb, the tāʾ is for the feminine, طائفة is the fāʿil (agent), and من أهل الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of طائفة; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لو يضلونكم﴾: لو is maṣdar-forming; يضلونكم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the agent and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لو﴾ together with what follows it is interpreted as an accusative maṣdar, because it is the object of ﴿ودت﴾; the implied sense is: "they wished for your being led astray".
﴿وما يضلون إلا أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; يضلون is a verb and its agent; إلا is a particle of restriction; أنفسهم is a direct object; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما يشعرون﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿يا أهل الكتاب لم تكفرون بآيات الله﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and أهل الكتاب is a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct; لم: the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām, the alif of ما having been dropped because it comes after a preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكفرون; تكفرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تكفرون.
﴿وأنتم تشهدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); تشهدون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the clause is the khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿أنتم تشهدون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿يا أهل الكتاب لم تلبسون الحق بالباطل﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and أهل الكتاب is a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct; لم: the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām, the alif of ما having been dropped because it comes after a preposition; تلبسون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الحق is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تلبسون.
﴿وتكتمون الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; تكتمون is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the agent, and الحق is a direct object.
﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تعلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the verbal clause تعلمون is the khabar (predicate) of أنتم. The nominal clause ﴿وأنتم تعلمون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿وقالت طائفة من أهل الكتاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قالت is a past verb; طائفة is the fāʿil (agent); and من أهل الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of طائفة.
﴿آمنوا بالذي أنزل على الذين آمنوا﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); آمنوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; بالذي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنوا; the clause ﴿أنزل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position; أنزل is a past verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it"; على الذين آمنوا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of ﴿الذي﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the relative noun here is الذين], with no grammatical position.
﴿وجه النهار﴾: an adverb of time attached to آمنوا.
﴿واكفروا آخره﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اكفروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, conjoined to آمنوا; and آخره is an adverb of time attached to اكفروا.
﴿لعلهم يرجعون﴾: the clause of hope is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "hoping for their return from their religion"; لعل is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause يرجعون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿ولا تؤمنوا إلا لمن تبع دينكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تؤمنوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of exception; لمن: the lām is a preposition, and من is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative as excepted from an omitted [element], its implied form being "and do not believe"; تبع is a past verb whose agent is "he", and the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and دينكم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قل إن الهدى هدى الله﴾: ﴿قل﴾ is an imperative verb; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle; ﴿الهدى﴾ is its noun and ﴿هدى الله﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause of ﴿إن﴾ is maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); and the clause ﴿قل إن الهدى هدى الله﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿أن يؤتى أحد مثل ما أوتيتم﴾: أن and what falls in its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تؤمنوا; أحد is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يؤتى; مثل is a second direct object; ما is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by annexation; and the clause أوتيتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿أو يحاجوكم عند ربكم﴾: أو is a conjunction; يحاجوكم is an imperfect verb conjoined to يؤتى, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent and the kāf is a direct object; عند is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ربكم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قل إن الفضل بيد الله﴾: قل is an imperative verb whose agent is "you"; إن is an abrogating particle; الفضل is its noun; بيد الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and إن with what falls in its scope is a nominal clause in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
﴿يؤتيه من يشاء﴾: the clause يؤتيه is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl; يؤتي is an imperfect verb whose agent is "he"; the hāʾ is the first object of يؤتي; من is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as the second object of يؤتي; and the clause يشاء is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله واسع عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); واسع is a first khabar and عليم a second khabar. The clause ﴿والله واسع عليم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿يختص برحمته من يشاء﴾: the clause is a third khabar (predicate); يختص is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is "he", i.e. Allah the Exalted; برحمته is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يختص; من is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause يشاء has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿والله ذو الفضل العظيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ذو is the khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw in place of the ḍamma, because it is one of the Five Nouns; الفضل is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and العظيم is an adjective (ṣifa) of الفضل.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ومن أهل الكتاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من أهل الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿من إن تأمنه بقنطار يؤده إليك﴾: من is a relative noun, the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); or: an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, i.e. "people", and it is the delayed mubtadaʾ; إن is conditional; تأمنه is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil (agent) is "you"; بقنطار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأمنه; يؤده is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the hāʾ is a direct object; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤده; and the conditional clause with its apodosis is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, having no grammatical position, or an adjective of the indefinite noun, in the position of a nominative.
﴿ومنهم من إن تأمنه بدينار لا يؤده إليك﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿إلا ما دمت عليه قائما﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction; ما دمت is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun and قائمًا its khabar; عليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قائمًا﴾; and the exception is emptied (mufarragh) from the general adverb, so it is an adverb.
﴿ذلك بأنهم قالوا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; the bāʾ is a preposition, and أن with what follows it is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause قالوا is the khabar of أن.
﴿ليس علينا في الأميين سبيل﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of their speech; ليس is a defective past verb; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ليس; في الأميين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and سبيل is the delayed noun of ليس.
﴿ويقولون على الله الكذب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يقولون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقولون; الكذب is a direct object, and it is also said: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a description of the maṣdar, i.e. "the lying speech". The clause ﴿ويقولون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهم يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; and the clause يعلمون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿بلى من أوفى بعهده واتقى﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; بلى is an answering particle for cancelling a negation, so here it cancels their saying: ﴿ليس علينا في الأميين سبيل﴾; من is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); أوفى is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); بعهده is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوفى; and اتقى is conjoined to أوفى.
﴿فإن الله يحب المتقين﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يحب is its khabar (predicate); المتقين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿فإن الله﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿إن الذين يشترون بعهد الله وأيمانهم ثمنا قليلا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle; الذين is its noun; the clause يشترون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; بعهد الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يشترون, the bāʾ entering on what is given up; أيمانهم is conjoined to بعهد الله; ثمنًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and قليلًا an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿أولئك لا خلاق لهم في الآخرة﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); لا is the lā of generic negation; خلاق is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); في الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿لا خلاق لهم﴾ is the khabar of أولئك, and the demonstrative clause with what follows it is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿ولا يكلمهم الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating; يكلمهم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the hāʾ is a fronted direct object and the Name of Majesty is a delayed fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا خلاق لهم﴾.
﴿ولا ينظر إليهم﴾: also conjoined.
﴿يوم القيامة﴾: the adverb is attached to ينظر.
﴿ولا يزكيهم﴾: conjoined to ﴿ولا ينظر إليهم﴾.
﴿ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ and أليم an adjective; the clause is also conjoined.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿وإن منهم لفريقا يلوون ألسنتهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); فريقًا is the delayed noun of إن; the clause يلوون is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿فريقًا﴾; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ألسنتهم is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and بالكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يلوون.
﴿لتحسبوه من الكتاب﴾: the lām is the lām of causation; تحسبوه is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the nūn has been dropped because it is one of the Five Verbs; the hāʾ is the first object of تحسبوه; من الكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun in the place of the second object; the implied أن with what follows it is in the position of a genitive by the lām; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يلوون.
﴿وما هو من الكتاب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is the Ḥijāzī negating ما, which operates like ليس; هو is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as the noun of ما; and ﴿من الكتاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of ما; or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-operative negating particle, ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من الكتاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويقولون هو من عند الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يقولون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and it is conjoined to يلوون; هو is a mubtadaʾ, and من عند الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech).
﴿وما هو من عند الله﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is the Ḥijāzī negating ما, which operates like ليس; هو is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as the noun of ما; and ﴿من عند﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of ما; or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-operative negating particle, ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and ﴿من عند﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ويقولون على الله الكذب﴾: conjoined to what preceded; يقولون is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the agent; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقولون; and الكذب is a direct object, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a description of the maṣdar, i.e. "the lying speech".
﴿وهم يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; and the clause يعلمون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:154-154.t:
﴿ثم أنزل عليكم من بعد الغم أمنة نعاسا﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī); أنزل is a past verb, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿فأثابكم﴾, and أثابكم is conjoined to صرفكم; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; ﴿من بعد الغم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to أنزل; أمنة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿نعاسًا﴾ is a badal (substitute) of أمنة.
﴿يغشى طائفة منكم﴾: the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of His saying ﴿نعاسًا﴾; طائفة is the mafʿūl bihi of يغشى; ومنك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of طائفة. [Translator's note: the source has «ومنك», evidently for ﴿منكم﴾.]
﴿وطائفة قد أهمتهم أنفسهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); طائفة is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿قد أهمتهم أنفسهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿يظنون بالله غير الحق ظن الجاهلية﴾: the clause ﴿يظنون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of ﴿أهمتهم﴾, which is the attached pronoun of the absent [plural]; and it was said: the clause ﴿قد أهمتهم أنفسهم﴾ is an adjective, and the clause ﴿يظنون﴾ is the khabar; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يظنون﴾; ﴿غير الحق﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is its adjective, the implied form being: "they think of Allah a thought other than the true thought"; ﴿ظن الجاهلية﴾ is a badal of it; on this [view], no two objects are mentioned for يظنون. Or: ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to [an omitted] second object of ﴿يظنون﴾, and ﴿غير الحق﴾ is the first object of يظنون, the implied form being: "they think [something] other than the truth to be [the case] regarding Allah"; and ﴿ظن الجاهلية﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq.
﴿يقولون هل لنا من الأمر من شيء﴾: the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is a badal of the clause ﴿يظنون﴾; ﴿هل﴾ is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī) whose meaning is negation, i.e. "we have not"; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿من الأمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and شيء is genitive (majrūr) by من in form, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قل إن الأمر كله لله﴾: قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿الأمر﴾ is its noun (ism); كله is a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿الأمر﴾; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إن; the clause ﴿إن الأمر...﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of saying. The clause ﴿قل إن الأمر...﴾ is resumptive or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and on both views it has no grammatical position.
﴿يخفون في أنفسهم ما لا يبدون لك﴾: the clause ﴿يخفون﴾ is a ḥāl from the pronoun of يقولون, i.e. "they say among themselves, whispering to one another"; ﴿في أنفسهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يخفون; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; ﴿لا﴾ is negating; the clause ﴿يبدون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يبدون.
﴿يقولون لو كان لنا من الأمر شيء ما قتلنا ههنا﴾: the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of كان; ﴿من الأمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿شيء﴾ is the postponed noun of كان; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿قتلنا﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); ﴿نا﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿ما قتلنا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; ها هنا: ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh), and ﴿هنا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of an accusative as an adverb of place, attached to ﴿قتلنا﴾.
﴿قل لو كنتم في بيوتكم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; كنتم is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; في بيوتكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying.
﴿لبرز الذين كتب عليهم القتل إلى مضاجعهم﴾: the lām occurs in the answer; ﴿برز الذين﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿كتب عليهم القتل﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿إلى مضاجعهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿برز﴾.
﴿وليبتلي الله ما في صدوركم﴾: the wāw is conjoining to something omitted; وليبتلي: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and يبتلي is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted verb; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; ﴿في صدوركم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وليمحص ما في قلوبكم﴾: conjoined to ﴿ليبتلي ما في صدوركم﴾.
﴿والله عليم بذات الصدور﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, to affirm His knowledge (Exalted is He) of secrets and hidden things, with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; عليم is the khabar; ﴿بذات الصدور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم.

muyesser-irab:155-155.t:
﴿إن الذين تولوا منكم يوم التقى الجمعان﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; الذين is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿تولوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿تولوا﴾; the clause ﴿التقى﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct).
﴿إنما استزلهم الشيطان ببعض ما كسبوا﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿إنما﴾ is a restraining [ما] and a restrained [إن] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿استزلهم الشيطان﴾ is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); ﴿ببعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استزلهم; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by iḍāfa; the clause كسبوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted.
﴿ولقد عفا الله عنهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿عفا الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عفا﴾.
﴿إن الله غفور حليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿غفور حليم﴾ are two khabars of إن; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) for His saying: عفا عنهم.

muyesser-irab:156-156.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and أي is a munādā (one addressed) that is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), and hā is for alerting (tanbīh). الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾. ﴿آمنوا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تكونوا كالذين كفروا﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive (nāhiya); ﴿تكونوا﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿كالذين﴾: the kāf is a noun in the meaning of "like" (mithl), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا, and الذين is a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the prohibition clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقالوا لإخوانهم إذا ضربوا في الأرض﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila; إذا is an adverb [used] for narrating a past state, and the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) قالوا; the clause ﴿ضربوا في الأرض﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa because it occurs after the adverb.
﴿أو كانوا غزى﴾: conjoined to the clause ضربوا في الأرض; غزى is the khabar of كانوا, and the wāw is its noun.
﴿لو كانوا عندنا ما ماتوا وما قتلوا﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective, abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; ﴿عندنا﴾ is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar of كان, i.e. "staying with us"; the clause ﴿ما ماتوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; and the clause ﴿ما قتلوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ما ماتوا﴾.
﴿ليجعل الله ذلك حسرة في قلوبهم﴾: the lām is the lām of consequence (ʿāqiba), or of outcome (ṣayrūra); يجعل is an imperfect verb, accusative by أن optionally implied after the lām of consequence; it and the maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by it are attached to an omitted verb understood from the context, i.e. "they said that and believed it"; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; ذلك is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and حسرة the second mafʿūl bihi; في قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of حسرة.
﴿والله يحيي ويميت﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يحيي﴾ is the khabar; the clause ﴿والله يحيي﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿يميت﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يحيي﴾.
﴿والله بما تعملون بصير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصير; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; بصير is the khabar of the Name of Majesty; and the clause ﴿والله بما...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿ما كان لبشر أن يؤتيه الله الكتاب والحكم والنبوة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لبشر is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); أن is a maṣdar-forming, accusative-governing particle; يؤتيه is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن and what falls in its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, the delayed noun of كان; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) of يؤتيه; الكتاب is the second direct object; and الحكم and النبوة are conjoined.
﴿ثم يقول للناس﴾: ثم is a conjunction for delay; the clause يقول is conjoined to يؤتيه; and للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقول.
﴿كونوا عبادا لي من دون الله﴾: the clause is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); كونوا is a defective, abrogating imperative verb; the wāw is its noun and عبادًا its khabar; لي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عبادًا﴾; and من دون الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولكن كونوا ربانيين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is lightened from the heavy form and inoperative; كونوا is a defective imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun and ربانيين its khabar; the clause كونوا ربانيين is in the position of the object of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "but he says: be".
﴿بما كنتم تعلمون الكتاب﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ with what follows it is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ربانيين﴾ because of the flavour of the verb in it; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb; the tāʾ is its noun; the clause تعلمون الكتاب is its khabar; and الكتاب is a direct object.
﴿وبما كنتم تدرسون﴾: conjoined to ﴿بما كنتم﴾, and the clause تدرسون is the khabar of ﴿كنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿ولا يأمركم أن تتخذوا الملائكة والنبيين أربابا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لا﴾ is connective (ṣila), to reinforce the negation in His saying: ﴿ما كان لبشر أن يؤتيه﴾; يأمركم is an imperfect verb conjoined to يؤتيه. أن تتخذوا: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأمر﴾; الملائكة is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); النبيين is conjoined to الملائكة, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; and أربابًا is the second direct object.
﴿أيأمركم بالكفر بعد إذ أنتم مسلمون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the hamza is for interrogation of rebuke; يأمركم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose agent is "he", and the kāf is a direct object; بالكفر is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأمركم; ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿يأمركم﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and مسلمون is its khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause ﴿أنتم مسلمون﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿وإذ أخذ الله ميثاق النبيين﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember"; the clause ﴿أخذ﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); ميثاق is a direct object; and النبيين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿لما آتيتكم من كتاب وحكمة﴾: the lām with fatḥa paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); it is also said: it is the lām of inception with which the oath is answered; ما is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause آتيتكم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; من كتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and حكمة is conjoined to كتاب.
﴿ثم جاءكم رسول مصدق لما معكم﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; جاءكم is a past verb and the kāf is a direct object; رسول is the delayed agent, nominative (marfūʿ); مصدق is an adjective (ṣifa); لما: the lām is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدق; معكم is an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿لتؤمنن به ولتنصرنه﴾: the wāw [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle here is the lām] occurs in the answer to an implied oath; تؤمنن is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters, the original being لتؤمنونن; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the agent, and the ḍamma remained as an indication of it; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis, with no grammatical position; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تؤمنن; ولتنصرنه is conjoined to لتؤمنن, and the hāʾ is a direct object; the implied oath clause and its answer are the khabar (predicate) of ما.
﴿قال أأقررتم وأخذتم على ذلكم إصري﴾: قال is a past verb whose agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; the hamza is for interrogation of affirmation and emphasis; أقررتم is a verb and its agent; the clause ﴿أقررتم﴾ is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); أخذتم is conjoined to أقررتم; على ذلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخذتم; إصري is a direct object, and the yāʾ of the speaker is an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive by annexation. The clause ﴿قال أأقررتم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا أقررنا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause أقررنا is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
﴿قال فاشهدوا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قال is a past verb whose agent is "he"; فاشهدوا: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اشهدوا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the agent; and the clause has no grammatical position.
﴿وأنا معكم من الشاهدين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; أنا is a mubtadaʾ; معكم is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl; من الشاهدين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause أنا معكم is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿فمن تولى بعد ذلك﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; من is conditional, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); تولى is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); بعد is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولى; and ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive by annexation. The clause ﴿فمن تولى...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأولئك هم الفاسقون﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and الفاسقون is the khabar (predicate); or ﴿هم الفاسقون﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the khabar of أولئك; the two clauses of the protasis and its apodosis are in the position of a nominative as the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿أفغير دين الله يبغون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of rebuke; the fāʾ is a conjunction joining a clause to a clause; and it is also said: it is conjoined to something omitted, its implied form being "do they turn away, and so seek other than the religion of Allah?"; يبغون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the Five Verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿وله أسلم من في السماوات والأرض طوعا وكرها﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسلم; أسلم is a past verb, and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); من is a relative noun, the agent of أسلم; في السماوات: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. الأرض is conjoined to السماوات; طوعًا: a maṣdar, accusative as a ḥāl, meaning "willingly obedient"; and كرها: conjoined to ﴿طوعًا﴾, accusative.
﴿وإليه يرجعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يرجعون﴾.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿قل آمنا بالله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "you"; آمنا is a past verb and its agent; the clause آمنا is maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); and بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا.
﴿وما أنزل علينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is a relative noun conjoined to the Name of Majesty; and the clause أنزل علينا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما أنزل على إبراهيم وإسماعيل وإسحاق ويعقوب والأسباط﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is a noun conjoined to the first ما; أنزل is a past verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it"; the clause أنزل is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; على إبراهيم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنزل; and the successive names are conjoined to إبراهيم.
﴿وما أوتي موسى وعيسى والنبيون من ربهم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; أوتي is a past verb, passive; موسى is the deputy agent, and what follows it is conjoined to it; and من ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوتي.
﴿لا نفرق بين أحد منهم﴾: لا is negating; نفرق is an imperfect verb whose agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "we"; بين is an adverb of place attached to نفرق; أحد is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أحد; and the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿ونحن له مسلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; نحن is a mubtadaʾ (subject); له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مسلمون﴾; مسلمون is the khabar (predicate) of نحن; and the clause ﴿ونحن له مسلمون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t:
﴿ومن يبتغ غير الإسلام دينا فلن يقبل منه﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يبتغ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; غير is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يبتغ, and دينًا is a tamyīz (specification). Or: ﴿غير﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of ﴿دينًا﴾ and then was placed before it, and دينًا is the direct object. فلن: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لن is a particle of negation, accusative-governing and future; يقبل is an imperfect verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), accusative (manṣūb) by لن; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقبل; the clause لن يقبل منه is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of من.
﴿وهو في الآخرة من الخاسرين﴾: the wāw is for conjunction; هو is a mubtadaʾ; في الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الخاسرين; من الخاسرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of هو; and the clause is conjoined to the apodosis. Or the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿كيف يهدي الله قوماكفروا بعد إيمانهم﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source heading, with قوما and كفروا run together]: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; كيف is an interrogative noun whose meaning is denial and negation, i.e. "Allah does not guide", and it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); يهدي is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); قومًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause كفروا is an adjective (ṣifa) of قومًا; بعد is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) كفروا; and إيمانهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وشهدوا أن الرسول حق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [joining it] to the verbal sense contained in ﴿إيمانهم﴾, because its meaning is "after they believed in Allah"; it is also said: the wāw does not entail sequence, so it is conjoined to كفروا. It is also said: the wāw is circumstantial, with ﴿قد﴾ implied after it, i.e. "while they had borne witness". أن is an abrogating particle, الرسول is its noun and ﴿حق﴾ its khabar (predicate); it and what falls in its scope are in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "to the fact that the Messenger is true", so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to شهدوا.
﴿وجاءهم البينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جاءهم is a past verb and a direct object; البينات is the agent; the clause is conjoined to the clause شهدوا; or the wāw is circumstantial with قد implied, i.e. "while they had borne witness", so the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿والله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause لا يهدي is the khabar; القوم is a direct object; and الظالمين is an adjective of القوم. The clause ﴿والله لا يهدي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿أولئك جزاؤهم أن عليهم لعنة الله﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أولئك is a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as the first mubtadaʾ (subject); جزاؤهم is a second mubtadaʾ; أن and what falls in its scope are the khabar (predicate) of جزاؤهم; the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar of أن; and لعنة الله is the delayed noun of أن.
﴿والملائكة والناس أجمعين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الملائكة is conjoined to the Name of Majesty, and الناس is also conjoined; أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿خالدين فيها﴾: خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين.
﴿لا يخفف عنهم العذاب﴾: the clause is a second ḥāl; لا is negating; يخفف is an imperfect verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named); عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخفف; and العذاب is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿ولا هم ينظرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating; هم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); ينظرون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the deputy agent; the clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾, and the clause is conjoined to the clause لا يخفف.

muyesser-irab:157-157.t:
﴿ولئن قتلتم في سبيل الله أو متم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the lām paves the way (muwaṭṭiʾa) for the implied oath; إن is conditional; ﴿قتلتم﴾ is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it is built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿في سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قتلتم; أو [is a particle of] conjunction; ﴿متم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿لمغفرة من الله ورحمة خير مما يجمعون﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); مغفرة is the mubtadaʾ (subject); رحمة is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to مغفرة; خير is the khabar (predicate); ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير; the clause ﴿يجمعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the lām of inception with what it governs is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:158-158.t:
﴿ولئن متم أو قتلتم﴾: ﴿ولئن﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, the lām paves the way (muwaṭṭiʾa) for the implied oath, and إن is conditional; ﴿متم﴾ is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿قتلتم﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿لإلى الله تحشرون﴾: the lām and what it governs are the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer to the oath indicates it and fulfils its meaning; ﴿وإلى الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تحشرون﴾; ﴿تحشرون﴾ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named, and the wāw of the group is the nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:159-159.t:
﴿فبما رحمة من الله لنت لهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿بما رحمة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لنت﴾, and ﴿ما﴾ is connective (ṣila) for emphasis; من الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة; لنت is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿لنت﴾.
﴿ولو كنت فظا غليظ القلب لانفضوا من حولك﴾: the wāw is conjoining to an omitted, implied [clause], i.e. "you were gentle, even if you had not been gentle"; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; كنت: a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿فظًّا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); لانفضوا: the lām occurs in the answer of ﴿لو﴾, and ﴿انفضوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; من حولك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انفضوا.
﴿فاعف عنهم واستغفر لهم﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa [fāʾ that discloses an omitted condition]; ﴿اعف﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil being "you" (anta); عنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اعف﴾; ﴿واستغفر﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿اعف﴾; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استغفر﴾.
﴿وشاورهم في الأمر﴾: likewise conjoined; ﴿في الأمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شاورهم﴾.
﴿فإذا عزمت فتوكل على الله﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, or resumptive, the clause after it being resumptive, with no grammatical position; إذا is an adverb of future time; the clause ﴿عزمت﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct); ﴿فتوكل﴾: the fāʾ links the answer of إذا, and ﴿توكل﴾ is an imperative verb, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿توكل﴾.
﴿إن الله يحب المتوكلين﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; and the clause ﴿يحب المتوكلين﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:160-160.t:
﴿إن ينصركم الله فلا غالب لكم﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; ينصركم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); فلا: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and ﴿لا﴾ is the lā of generic negation, operating like inna; ﴿غالب﴾ is its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the clause ﴿فلا غالب لكم﴾ is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿وإن يخذلكم فمن ذا الذي ينصركم من بعده﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is conditional; ﴿يخذلكم﴾ is the protasis; ﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and ﴿من﴾ is a noun of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī) in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as the khabar of ﴿من﴾; ﴿الذي﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative; ﴿من بعده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the nominal clause ﴿فمن﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the clause ينصركم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿على الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتوكل; the fāʾ is for emphasising the resumption; the lām is the lām of command; يتوكل is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām; and المؤمنون is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:161-161.t:
﴿وما كان لنبي أن يغل﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; ﴿لنبي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يغل﴾ is its postponed noun (ism).
﴿ومن يغلل يأت بما غل يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the speech after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-making conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿يغلل﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and ﴿يأت﴾ its apodosis (jawāb); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأت﴾; the clause ﴿غل﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ is an adverb of time, also attached to ﴿يأت﴾; and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿ثم توفى كل نفس ما كسبت﴾: ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī); ﴿توفى﴾ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to the conditional clause; ﴿كل نفس﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿كسبت﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; the clause لا يظلمون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:162-162.t:
﴿أفمن اتبع رضوان الله﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī); the fāʾ is conjoining to something omitted; ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿اتبع﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿رضوان الله﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿اتبع﴾; and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to the omitted [clause].
﴿كمن باء بسخط من الله﴾: ﴿كمن﴾: the kāf is a noun in the meaning of "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; مَن is a relative noun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿باء﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿بسخط﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿باء﴾; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
