﴿ومأواه جهنم وبئس المصير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مأواه﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿جهنم﴾ its khabar; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila; ﴿وبئس﴾: the wāw is likewise conjunctive, and ﴿بئس﴾ is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; ﴿المصير﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. Jahannam.

muyesser-irab:163-163.t:
﴿هم درجات عند الله﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿درجات﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿عند الله﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of درجات.
﴿والله بصير بما يعملون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; بصير is the khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصير; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿والله بصير﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:164-164.t:
﴿لقد من الله على المؤمنين﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); ﴿من الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿على المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿من﴾; and the speech is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إذ بعث فيهم رسولا من أنفسهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to ﴿مَنَّ﴾; the clause ﴿بعث﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct); ﴿فيهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بعث﴾; ﴿رسولًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من أنفسهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رسولًا﴾.
﴿يتلو عليهم آياته﴾: the clause is a second adjective of ﴿رسولًا﴾; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتلو﴾.
﴿ويزكيهم ويعلمهم الكتاب والحكمة﴾: the two clauses are conjoined (maʿṭūfatān) to ﴿يتلو﴾; ﴿الكتاب﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يعلمهم﴾; ﴿الحكمة﴾ is conjoined to ﴿الكتاب﴾.
﴿وإن كانوا من قبل لفي ضلال مبين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿إن﴾ is lightened from the heavy [inna], inoperative, without governing effect; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism); ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and ﴿قبل﴾ is an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of a genitive by ﴿من﴾; لفي: the lām is the distinguishing [lām] (al-fāriqa); ﴿في ضلال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان; ﴿مبين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:165-165.t:
﴿أولما أصابتكم مصيبة﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī) and rebuke; the wāw is conjoining to what preceded of the story of Uḥud; لما is temporal, [meaning] "when," attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قلتم﴾, or it is a linking [particle], in which case it is a particle; ﴿أصابتكم﴾ is a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and مصيبة is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿قد أصبتم مثليها﴾: the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of مصيبة; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); أصبتم is a verb and its fāʿil; مثليها is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قلتم أنى هذا﴾: the clause ﴿قلتم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; ﴿أنى﴾ is an interrogative noun, a fronted khabar (predicate); هذا is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قل هو من عند أنفسكم﴾: the clause of what is said is the object of saying; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿من عند أنفسكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿إن الله على كل شيء قدير﴾: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); قدير is its khabar; ﴿على كل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:166-166.t:
﴿وما أصابكم يوم التقى الجمعان﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿أصابكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) أصابكم; the clause ﴿التقى الجمعان﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa (genitive construct).
﴿فبإذن الله وليعلم المؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is linking, because of the scent of condition in the relative noun; ﴿بإذن الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "so it is by the permission of Allah"; the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of the relative noun; ﴿وليعلم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and يعلم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to that to which ﴿بإذن﴾ is attached, or attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He did that so that He might know"; ﴿المؤمنين﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الم﴾: the discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Surat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) for the position of لا together with its noun, because their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal for the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is the khabar of the Name of Majesty.
﴿الحي﴾: a second khabar.
﴿القيوم﴾: a third khabar; or ﴿الحي القيوم﴾ are two naʿts (adjectives) of ﴿الله﴾, Mighty and Majestic is He.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿نزل عليك الكتاب بالحق﴾: the clause is a fourth khabar (predicate) of the Name of Majesty, or a second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). نزل is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نزل; الكتاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and بالحق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب, i.e. "invested with the truth".
﴿مصدقا لما بين يديه﴾: مصدقًا is an emphatic ḥāl; the lām is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to His saying ﴿مصدقًا﴾; بين is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; يديه is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive by the yāʾ because it is dual, its nūn having been dropped for annexation; and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وأنزل التوراة والإنجيل﴾: conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿من قبل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل.
﴿هدى للناس﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of التوراة and الإنجيل; it has also been said: a mafʿūl min ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "He sent down these two books for the sake of guiding people". للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هدى.
﴿وأنزل الفرقان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause أنزل الفرقان is conjoined to the clause أنزل التوراة والإنجيل.
﴿إن الذين كفروا بآيات الله﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); الذين is its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to كفروا.
﴿لهم عذاب شديد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); شديد is a naʿt (adjective); and the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إن.
﴿والله عزيز ذو انتقام﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; عزيز is a first khabar, and ذو انتقام is a second khabar. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿إن الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), and the Name of Majesty is its noun.
﴿لا يخفى عليه شيء﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of شيء.
﴿ولا في السماء﴾: conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿هو الذي يصوركم في الأرحام﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause يصوركم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and في الأرحام is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصوركم.
﴿كيف يشاء﴾: كيف here is a conditional particle in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the object of يشاء is omitted, its implied form being "your shaping"; and the clause is circumstantial.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) for the position of لا together with its noun, because their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal for the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar.
﴿العزيز الحكيم﴾: two khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He".

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿هو الذي أنزل عليك الكتاب﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذي is its khabar (predicate); the clause أنزل عليك الكتاب has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنزل; and الكتاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿منه آيات محكمات﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; آيات is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and محكمات is a naʿt (adjective) of آيات.
﴿هن أم الكتاب﴾: the clause is a second naʿt of آيات; هن is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ, and أم الكتاب is its khabar.
﴿وأخر متشابهات﴾: conjoined to آيات محكمات.
﴿فأما الذين في قلوبهم زيغ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; أما is a particle of condition and of detailing; الذين is a mubtadaʾ; في قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; زيغ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فيتبعون ما تشابه﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis of أما; the clause يتبعون is the khabar of الذين; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause تشابه is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تشابه. The clause ﴿فأما الذين في قلوبهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ابتغاء﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿الفتنة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وابتغاء تأويله﴾: conjoined to ابتغاء الفتنة.
﴿وما يعلم تأويله﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is negative; يعلم is a nominative imperfect verb; تأويله is a fronted mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. [Translator's note: so in the source («مفعول به مقدم»), i.e. fronted before the fāʿil الله, which comes after إلا.]
﴿إلا الله﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction, and the Name of Majesty is the postponed fāʿil (agent) of يعلم.
﴿والراسخون في العلم يقولون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الراسخون is conjoined to the Name of Majesty, and the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is circumstantial, i.e. "saying". Or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; الراسخون is a mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the clause ﴿يقولون﴾.
﴿آمنا به﴾: the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); آمنا is a verb and its fāʿil; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنا.
﴿كل﴾: a mubtadaʾ, the tanwīn being a substitute for a word.
﴿من عند ربنا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿وما يذكر إلا أولو الألباب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, or resumptive with the clause after it resumptive and with no grammatical position; ما is negative; يذكر is a nominative imperfect verb; إلا is a particle of restriction; أولوا is the fāʿil of يذكر, nominative by the wāw, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; and الألباب is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ربنا is a munādā (one addressed) that is muḍāf; لا is the lā of request, used for supplication; تزغ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the fāʿil (agent) is "You"; قلوبنا is the object; ﴿بعد﴾ is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تزغ﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "after the time of Your guiding us"; and the clause هديتنا is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿وهب لنا من لدنك رحمة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هب is an imperative verb; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هب; من لدنك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); لدن is an adverb indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of the genitive by من, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; and رحمة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنك أنت الوهاب﴾: the clause gives the reason for the supplication, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), and the kāf is its noun; أنت is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); الوهاب is the khabar (predicate) of أنت; and the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إن. Or أنت is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and الوهاب is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿ربنا إنك جامع الناس﴾: ربنا is a munādā (one addressed) that is muḍāf; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the kāf is its noun, and جامع الناس is its khabar (predicate); and the clause falls within the scope of the object of saying.
﴿ليوم لا ريب فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جامع; لا is the lā of generic negation; ريب is its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar; and the clause لا ريب فيه is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of يوم.
﴿إن الله لا يخلف الميعاد﴾: the clause gives the reason for the content of the emphasised clause, or for the absence of doubt about the occurrence of the Day of Resurrection and the reward and punishment in it. ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; لا is negative; يخلف is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He"; الميعاد is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿لا يخلف الميعاد﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); الذين is its noun; and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لن﴾: a particle of negation, of the subjunctive (naṣb) and of the future.
﴿تغني﴾: an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by لن; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿عنهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تغني.
﴿أموالهم﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of تغني.
﴿ولا أولادهم﴾: conjoined to أموالهم.
﴿من الله﴾: من is a preposition, and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿شيئًا﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿وأولئك هم وقود النار﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the khabar of إن. أولئك is a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is a second mubtadaʾ; وقود النار is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative. Or هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), and وقود النار is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿كدأب آل فرعون﴾: ﴿كدأب﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being "the custom of these is like the custom of Pharaoh's people"; ﴿دأب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is itself muḍāf; ﴿آل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and it is itself muḍāf; and ﴿فرعون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa, because it is a diptote, being a proper name and foreign.
﴿والذين من قبلهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الذين is conjoined to ﴿آل فرعون﴾. من قبلهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); بآياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كذبوا﴾; and the clause is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or the wāw in ﴿والذين﴾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; الذين is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause ﴿كذبوا﴾.
﴿فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخذهم الله is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أخذهم, the bāʾ being causal; or [attached] to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the bāʾ then being of accompaniment, i.e. "laden with their sins".
﴿والله شديد العقاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, and شديد العقاب is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿قل للذين كفروا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. قل is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the Prophet ﷺ, i.e. "you". للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل; and the clause كفروا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿ستغلبون﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future; تغلبون is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وتحشرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause تحشرون is conjoined to ستغلبون, falling within the scope of the saying.
﴿إلى جهنم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحشرون; جهنم is genitive by the fatḥa, because it is a diptote, being a proper name and feminine.
﴿وبئس المهاد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, falling within the scope of the saying; or the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. بئس is a past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; المهاد is the fāʿil of بئس; and the one specified for blame is omitted, its implied form being "Hell".

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿إلا الذين تابوا﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; الذين is the excepted; and the clause تابوا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿من بعد ذلك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تابوا; ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive by annexation.
﴿وأصلحوا﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause تابوا.
﴿فإن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun; غفور is its first khabar (predicate) and رحيم its second khabar; the clause of exception is an overlapping ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. a ḥāl from a ḥāl, because خالدين is a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿عليهم﴾; and it is also said: rather, it is a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا بعد إيمانهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين is its noun; the clause كفروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; بعد is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) كفروا; and إيمانهم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ثم ازدادوا كفرا﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay; ازدادوا is a past verb, and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent); كفرًا is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the agent, i.e. "their disbelief increased"; زاد takes two objects, while its reflexive (muṭāwiʿ) form takes only one.
﴿لن تقبل توبتهم﴾: لن is an accusative-governing particle; تقبل is an imperfect verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), accusative (manṣūb) by لن; توبتهم is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿وأولئك هم الضالون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, so that we need no implied element in conjoining a nominal clause to a verbal clause; it is also said: it is circumstantial, and the meaning is "their repentance from sins will not be accepted while they are astray". أولئك is a demonstrative; هم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as a second mubtadaʾ (subject); الضالون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the demonstrative; or ﴿هم﴾ is a detached pronoun with no grammatical position, and الضالون is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا وماتوا وهم كفار﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين is its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ماتوا is conjoined to كفروا; وهم: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and هم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); كفار is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلن يقبل من أحدهم ملء الأرض ذهبا﴾: the fāʾ links the answer because of the flavour of condition in the relative noun; لن is an accusative-governing particle; يقبل is an imperfect verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the clause is the khabar of إن; من أحدهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يقبل; ملء is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); الأرض is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ذهبًا is a tamyīz (specification), accusative by removal of the preposition.
﴿ولو افتدى به﴾: the wāw is a conjunction [joining] to something omitted; لو is a non-jussivizing conditional particle; افتدى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and its fāʿil (agent) is "he"; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to افتدى.
﴿أولئك لهم عذاب أليم﴾: the clause as a whole is a second khabar of إن; أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; and أليم is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿وما لهم من ناصرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; من is a connective (ṣila) particle; and ناصرين is genitive by من in form, nominative in position as the delayed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿لن تنالوا البر حتى تنفقوا مما تحبون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; لن is a particle of negation, accusative-governing and future; تنالوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, because it is one of the Five Verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent); البر is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; تنفقوا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an obligatorily implied أن after حتى, and the implied ﴿أن﴾ with the imperfect verb after it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنالوا; the wāw is the agent; مما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تنفقوا; and the clause تحبون has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ما.
﴿وما تنفقوا من شيء فإن الله به عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of an accusative as a fronted direct object of تنفقوا; تنفقوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is the agent; من شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تنفقوا; فإن: the fāʾ links to the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), standing as a causal explanation of it; إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عليم is its khabar (predicate); به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليم. The clause ﴿وما تنفقوا من شيء...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿كل الطعام كان حلا لبني إسرائيل﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. كل is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause كان حلًّا is its khabar (predicate); كان is a past verb whose noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it", and حلًّا is its khabar; لبني إسرائيل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) His word ﴿حلًّا﴾; and إسرائيل is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, the impediment being its being a proper name and foreign.
﴿إلا ما حرم إسرائيل على نفسه﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; ما is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as excepted from the latent noun of كان; the clause حرم has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; إسرائيل is the fāʿil (agent); على نفسه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حرم; and the clause of exception is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿من قبل أن تنزل التوراة﴾: من قبل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حلًّا, as suits the meaning; أن and what [falls in] its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar in annexation, genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; and التوراة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿قل فأتوا بالتوراة فاتلوها إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it discloses an implied condition, i.e. "if you are confident of your statements and insist on them, then bring the Torah"; أتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; بالتوراة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتوا; the clause is maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech). فاتلوها: the fāʾ is a conjunction; اتلوها is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent; ﴿ها﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun and صادقين its khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by ﴿فأتوا بالتوراة﴾.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿فمن افترى على الله الكذب﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a non-jussivizing conditional noun [Translator's note: so in the source, although it then speaks of the verb as being in the position of a jussive] in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); افترى is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to ﴿من﴾; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) افترى; and الكذب is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من بعد ذلك﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to افترى, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فأولئك هم الظالمون﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; هم is a second mubtadaʾ; الظالمون is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the nominal clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; [or] هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) and الظالمون is the khabar of أولئك; the demonstrative clause with what follows it is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿قل صدق الله فاتبعوا ملة إبراهيم حنيفا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you"; صدق الله is a past verb and its agent, and the clause is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); فاتبعوا: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اتبعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, because its imperfect is one of the Five Verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative as agent; ملة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إبراهيم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and حنيفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما كان من المشركين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he", referring to Ibrāhīm; and من المشركين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿إن أول بيت وضع للناس للذي ببكة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); أول is its noun; بيت is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); وضع is a past verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it"; للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) وضع; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of بيت; للذي: the lām with fatḥa is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and الذي is the relative noun in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن. ﴿ببكة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿مباركا وهدى للعالمين﴾: مباركًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun, or from the pronoun latent in what the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to; هدى is conjoined to ﴿مباركًا﴾; and للعالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هدى, i.e. "guiding them".

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿فيه آيات بينات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); آيات is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); بينات is an adjective (ṣifa) of آيات; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿مقام إبراهيم﴾: مقام is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "among them is the Station of Ibrāhīm", or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "one of them", i.e. one of those clear signs is the Station of Ibrāhīm; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن دخله كان آمنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; دخله is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he"; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its noun is latent, its implied form being "he"; آمنًا is the khabar of كان; and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of the conditional مَن. The clause ﴿ومن دخله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولله على الناس حج البيت من استطاع إليه سبيلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar; على الناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to what the khabar, namely ﴿لله﴾, is attached to; حج is the delayed mubtadaʾ; البيت is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من is a relative noun in the position of a badal (substitute) from الناس, a substitute of part for whole, with the pronoun omitted, i.e. "of them"; it is also said: ﴿من﴾ is the agent of the operative maṣdar ﴿حج﴾; the clause استطاع is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of ﴿سبيلًا﴾, and when it was placed before it, it was parsed as a ḥāl.
﴿ومن كفر فإن الله غني عن العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; من is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ, or a relative noun; كفر is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis, and its agent is "he"; the fāʾ gives the reason for the implied apodosis, i.e. "he will not harm Allah"; the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar; إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, غني is its khabar, and عن العالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غني.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿قل يا أهل الكتاب لم تكفرون بآيات الله﴾: قل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you", and the clause ﴿قل﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle, and أهل الكتاب is a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct; لم: the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām, the alif of the interrogative ما having been dropped because the preposition entered upon it; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكفرون; بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to تكفرون; the vocative clause ﴿يا أهل...﴾ is maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech), in the position of an accusative; and the clause answering the vocative, ﴿لم تكفرون بآيات الله...﴾, is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله شهيد على ما تعملون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and شهيد the khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to شهيد; the clause تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿والله شهيد﴾ is circumstantial, in the position of an accusative.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿قل يا أهل الكتاب لم تصدون عن سبيل الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "you"; يا is a vocative particle, and أهل الكتاب is a munādā (the one addressed) in a genitive construct; لم: the lām is a preposition, and ما is an interrogative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām, the alif of the interrogative ما having been dropped because the preposition entered upon it; تصدون is a verb and its agent; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تصدون.
﴿من آمن﴾: من is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of تصدون, and the clause آمن has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾.
﴿تبغونها عوجا﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); تبغونها is an imperfect verb, its agent and its direct object; عوجًا is a maṣdar interpreted as a derived form, a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "crooked". It is also said: the hāʾ in تبغونها is a pronoun, accusative by removal of the preposition.
﴿وأنتم شهداء﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); شهداء is the khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause is circumstantial.
﴿وما الله بغافل عما تعملون﴾: the wāw is also for the ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating ما, which operates like ليس; ﴿الله﴾, the Name of Majesty, is the noun of ما; ﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and غافل is genitive in form, accusative in position as the khabar of ﴿ما﴾; ﴿عما﴾: عن is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive, i.e. "of what you do", or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming and the interpreted maṣdar from ما and the verb ﴿تعملون﴾ is genitive by ﴿عن﴾, i.e. "of your doing"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿غافل﴾; and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:167-167.t:
﴿وليعلم الذين نافقوا﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿ليعلم﴾; الذين is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿نافقوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وقيل لهم تعالوا قاتلوا في سبيل الله أو ادفعوا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position, or conjoined to ﴿نافقوا﴾, falling within the scope of the relative noun, i.e. "and that He might know those from whom hypocrisy occurred"; ﴿قيل﴾ is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قيل﴾; the clause ﴿تعالوا﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl), [serving as] nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and likewise the clause ﴿قاتلوا﴾; ﴿في سبيل الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قاتلوا﴾; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; ﴿ادفعوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿قاتلوا﴾, and the object of ﴿ادفعوا﴾ is omitted because it is known.
﴿قالوا لو نعلم قتالا لاتبعناكم﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive (mustaʾnafa); ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; the clause ﴿لو نعلم قتالًا﴾ is the object of their saying; the lām occurs in the answer of ﴿لو﴾; ﴿اتبعناكم﴾ is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition.
﴿هم للكفر يومئذ أقرب منهم للإيمان﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿للكفر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أقرب﴾; ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time attached to ﴿أقرب﴾, and إذٍ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) sukūn because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); its tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, the implied form being: "they, on the day when they said 'If we knew [there would be] fighting, we would have followed you,' were nearer to disbelief than they were to faith." أقرب is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أقرب﴾; and للإيمان is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿أقرب﴾.
﴿يقولون بأفواههم ما ليس في قلوبهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿أقرب﴾, i.e. "they drew near to disbelief in the state of their saying this statement"; بأفواههم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقولون﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿ليس في قلوبهم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; في قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ليس.
﴿والله أعلم بما يكتمون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position, or the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; أعلم is the khabar; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعلم; the clause يكتمون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:168-168.t:
﴿الذين قالوا لإخوانهم وقعدوا﴾: الذين is a relative noun, a badal (substitute) of the relative noun in the preceding ayah, i.e. الذين نافقوا, or of the wāw in نافقوا; or: it is accusative (manṣūb) for blame by an omitted verb, its implied form being "I blame"; or nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause being resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause قالوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; لإخوانهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قالوا; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or conjunctive, and the clause is either a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in قالوا, with قد implied, or conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to the clause قالوا.
﴿لو أطاعونا ما قتلوا﴾: ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; أطاعونا is a past verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ما is negating; قتلوا is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ما قتلوا has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition; and the clause لو أطاعونا is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قل فادرءوا عن أنفسكم الموت إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, i.e. "if your claim is sound, then avert from yourselves," i.e. "repel"; عن أنفسكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ادرءوا; الموت is a mafʿūl bihi; إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun (ism); صادقين is the khabar of كنتم; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

muyesser-irab:169-169.t:
﴿ولا تحسبن الذين قتلوا في سبيل الله أمواتا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تحسبن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its being attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (anta); الذين is a relative noun, the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أمواتًا is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بل أحياء عند ربهم يرزقون﴾: ﴿بل﴾ is a conjunction that conjoins a clause to a clause; أحياء is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are alive"; ﴿عند ربهم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرزقون﴾, or attached to an omitted second khabar, or attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿يرزقون﴾ is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a third or second khabar.

muyesser-irab:170-170.t:
﴿فرحين بما آتاهم الله من فضله﴾: فرحين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿يرزقون﴾; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فرحين; the clause ﴿آتاهم الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿من فضله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آتاهم﴾; or: ﴿من﴾ is partitive (tabʿīḍiyya), attached together with its genitive noun to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ويستبشرون بالذين لم يلحقوا بهم من خلفهم﴾: the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to فرحين in terms of meaning, so it is a ḥāl; بالذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستبشرون﴾; the clause ﴿لم يلحقوا﴾ بهم is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; من خلفهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the wāw in لم يلحقوا.
﴿ألا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون﴾: ﴿أن﴾ is the one lightened from the heavy [anna], and its noun (ism) is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause ﴿لا خوف عليهم﴾ is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of the lightened أن; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and what is in its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "that there is no fear upon them," and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from ﴿الذين﴾; لا is negating; خوف is the mubtadaʾ (subject); عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; ﴿ولا هم يحزنون﴾ is conjoined to it: the wāw is conjunctive, لا is negating, and هم is the mubtadaʾ. يحزنون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يحزنون﴾ is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:171-171.t:
﴿يستبشرون بنعمة من الله وفضل﴾: the verb is repeated for emphasis; the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), a clause with no grammatical position, or emphasising the one before it, or a badal (substitute) of it; بنعمة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يستبشرون; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of نعمة; فضل is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to نعمة.
﴿وأن الله لا يضيع أجر المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); and the clause ﴿لا يضيع﴾ is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:172-172.t:
﴿الذين استجابوا لله والرسول﴾: the relative noun is a badal (substitute) of المؤمنين; the clause ﴿استجابوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استجابوا﴾; الرسول is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty.
﴿من بعد ما أصابهم القرح﴾: ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ما is maṣdariyya; ﴿أصابهم القرح﴾ is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); and the maṣdariyya ما with what is in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it.
﴿للذين أحسنوا منهم واتقوا أجر عظيم﴾: للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿أحسنوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; ﴿واتقوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أحسنوا﴾; ﴿أجر﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); عظيم is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿للذين أحسنوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:173-173.t:
﴿الذين قال لهم الناس﴾: الذين is a badal (substitute), or a second adjective (ṣifa) of الذين استجابوا; or: الذين is accusative (manṣūb) for praise by an omitted verb, the implied form being "praise!"; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; الناس is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إن الناس قد جمعوا لكم فاخشوهم﴾: the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; الناس is its noun (ism); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); the clause ﴿جمعوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جمعوا﴾; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; ﴿اخشوا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فزادهم إيمانًا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿زاد﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿قال﴾; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; إيمانًا is a second mafʿūl bihi, or a tamyīz (specification).
﴿وقالوا حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل﴾: ﴿وقالوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿زادهم﴾; حسبنا is a fronted khabar, and ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the Name of Majesty is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿ونعم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; نعم is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; الوكيل is the fāʿil; and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is Allah the Exalted.

muyesser-irab:174-174.t:
﴿فانقلبوا بنعمة من الله وفضل﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and the clause ﴿انقلبوا﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to something implied, understood from the context of the speech, i.e. "and they went out with the Prophet, and returned"; بنعمة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿انقلبوا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa); فضل is conjoined to نعمة.
﴿لم يمسسهم سوء﴾: the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); يمسسهم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سوء is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿واتبعوا رضوان الله﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause انقلبوا.
﴿والله ذو فضل عظيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ذو فضل is the khabar (predicate); عظيم is an adjective. The clause ﴿والله ذو...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:175-175.t:
﴿إنما ذلكم الشيطان يخوف أولياءه﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; إنما is a restraining [ما] and a restrained [إن] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ذلكم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); الشيطان is a second mubtadaʾ; the clause يخوف is the khabar (predicate) of الشيطان, and the second mubtadaʾ and its khabar are the khabar of the demonstrative; or: ذلكم is the mubtadaʾ, الشيطان is a badal (substitute) of ذلكم, and the clause يخوف is the khabar of ذلكم; or ذلكم is the mubtadaʾ and الشيطان its khabar, and the clause ﴿يخوف أولياءه﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فلا تخافوهم وخافون إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you trust in this, then do not fear them"; ﴿خافون﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿لا تخافوهم﴾; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ of the first person has been omitted optionally; إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating (nāsikh) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by ﴿إن﴾, and the answer is omitted, what precedes indicating it; مؤمنين is the khabar of ﴿كنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:176-176.t:
﴿ولا يحزنك الذين يسارعون في الكفر﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); يحزنك is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يسارعون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿في الكفر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسارعون﴾ because it is made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "they fall [into]."
﴿إنهم لن يضروا الله شيئا﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿لن يضروا الله﴾ is its khabar (predicate); شيئًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿يريد الله ألا يجعل لهم حظا في الآخرة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿يريد الله﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن﴾ and what is in its scope is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يريد﴾; حظًّا is the first object of يجعل; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; في الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿ولهم عذاب عظيم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); عظيم is an adjective of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:177-177.t:
﴿إن الذين اشتروا الكفر بالإيمان﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; الذين is its noun (ism); the clause اشتروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; الكفر is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بالإيمان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) اشتروا.
﴿لن يضروا الله شيئا﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن; شيئا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); أليم is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:178-178.t:
﴿ولا يحسبن الذين كفروا﴾: the wāw conjoins to His saying ولا يحزنك, or the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive (nāhiya); ﴿يحسبن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its being attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by لا; الذين is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنما نملي لهم خير لأنفسهم﴾: أن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ما is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is the noun (ism) of أن, i.e. "that Our granting respite"; or ﴿ما﴾ is relative, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of أن; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نملي﴾; خير is the khabar (predicate) of أن; لـ﴿أنفسهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير; and أن with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of ﴿يحسبن﴾.
﴿إنما نملي لهم ليزدادوا إثما﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿نملي﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نملي﴾; the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); ﴿يزدادوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of causation; أن and the verb are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نملي; the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿إثمًا﴾ is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿ولهم عذاب مهين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); مهين is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿قد كان لكم آية﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. قد is a particle of confirmation; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; and آية is its postponed noun.
﴿في فئتين التقتا﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية; the clause التقتا is a naʿt of the two groups; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine, given a fatḥa to suit the alif of the dual, which is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فئة تقاتل في سبيل الله﴾: فئة is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "one of them is a group"; and في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقاتل.
﴿وأخرى كافرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أخرى is conjoined to فئة; and كافرة is a naʿt.
﴿يرونهم مثليهم رأي العين﴾: the clause يرونهم is a naʿt of the group fighting in the way of Allah; يرونهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); مثليهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and رأي العين is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) emphasising its governing verb.
﴿والله يؤيد بنصره من يشاء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; the clause يؤيد is the khabar; بنصره is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يؤيد; من is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause يشاء has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause ﴿والله يؤيد...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن في ذلك لعبرة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); في ذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and عبرة is the postponed noun of إن.
﴿لأولي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of عبرة, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿الأبصار﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿زين للناس حب الشهوات﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. زين is a verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زين﴾; and حب الشهوات is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿من النساء والبنين والقناطير المقنطرة﴾: من is explicative (bayāniyya), and together with its genitive noun it is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). والبنين: the wāw is a conjunction, and البنين is conjoined to النساء, in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿المقنطرة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of القناطير.
﴿من الذهب والفضة والخيل المسومة والأنعام والحرث﴾: من is likewise explicative, and it and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl; what follows is conjoined to it.
﴿ذلك متاع الحياة الدنيا﴾: the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); متاع الحياة is the khabar (predicate); الدنيا is a naʿt; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله عنده حسن المآب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and what follows it is a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; the adverb is attached to an omitted fronted khabar; حسن المآب is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause is the khabar of the Name of Majesty.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is "you"; the statement is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أؤنبئكم بخير من ذلكم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (taqrīrī); أنبئ is a nominative imperfect verb; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I"; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بخير is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنبئكم, in the position of the accusative as the second object; من ذلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خير; and the interrogative clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿للذين اتقوا عند ربهم جنات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); the clause اتقوا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; عند ربهم is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of جنات, because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of it, and when it was placed before it, it was parsed as a ḥāl. جنات is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). Or: the adverb is attached to the [notion of] being-settled to which ﴿للذين﴾ is attached, because it is part of the "better thing"; ﴿للذين﴾ is a naʿt of خير, and جنات is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.
﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the clause is a naʿt of جنات; الأنهار is the fāʿil of تجري; and من تحتها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري.
﴿خالدين فيها﴾: a ḥāl of الذين اتقوا; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to خالدين.
﴿وأزواج مطهرة﴾: أزواج is conjoined to جنات, and مطهرة is a naʿt of أزواج.
﴿ورضوان من الله﴾: also conjoined to جنات.
﴿والله بصير بالعباد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. The Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; بصير is the khabar; and بالعباد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بصير.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿الذين يقولون﴾: a relative noun, a badal (substitute) for the relative noun in the previous ayah, or a naʿt (adjective) of it; it has also been said: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are those who", or accusative for praise by an omitted verb, i.e. "I praise those who". يقولون is an imperfect verb in the nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿ربنا إننا آمنا﴾: the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); ربنا is a munādā (one addressed) with the vocative particle omitted; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; and the clause آمنا is its khabar.
﴿فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا﴾: the fāʾ is causal, because faith is the cause of forgiveness; اغفر is a verb of supplication; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; and ذنوبنا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وقنا عذاب النار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قِ is a verb of supplication indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "You"; ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi; and عذاب النار is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿الصابرين والصادقين والقانتين والمنفقين والمستغفرين بالأسحار﴾: الصابرين is accusative for praise by an omitted verb, and what follows it is conjoined to it; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿شهد الله﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿أنه﴾: أن with what follows it is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "that He…" (بأنه); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شهد﴾.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) for the position of لا together with its noun, because their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); or a badal for the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿والملائكة وأولو العلم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الملائكة is conjoined to the Name of Majesty, and أولوا العلم is also conjoined, made nominative by the wāw because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
﴿قائما بالقسط﴾: a permanent ḥāl (circumstantial) of the Name of Majesty, or of the detached pronoun occurring after إلا.
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction.
﴿هو﴾: a badal for the position of لا together with its noun, because their position is the nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal for the pronoun concealed in the omitted khabar.
﴿العزيز الحكيم﴾: two khabars of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "He"; or they are two badals of ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿إن الدين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, emphasising the first; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), and الدين is its noun.
﴿عند الله﴾: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being and established with Allah".
﴿الإسلام﴾: the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿وما اختلف الذين أوتوا الكتاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; ما is negative; اختلف الذين is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause أوتوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; أوتوا is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object; and الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلا من بعد ما جاءهم العلم﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction; من بعد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اختلف; the interpreted maṣdar formed from maṣdarī ﴿ما﴾ with what follows it is genitive by annexation, i.e. "after the coming of knowledge to them"; جاءهم is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and العلم is its fāʿil.
﴿بغيا بينهم﴾: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); بينهم is an adverb of place attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective).
﴿ومن يكفر بآيات الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive (majzūm), in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); يكفر is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكفر.
﴿فإن الله سريع الحساب﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and سريع is its khabar; the nominal clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar of ﴿من﴾. The clause ﴿ومن يكفر بآيات...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿فإن حاجوك فقل﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; حاجوك is a past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is connective; قل is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿أسلمت وجهي لله﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); أسلمت is a verb and its fāʿil; وجهي is the mafʿūl bihi; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسلمت. The clause ﴿فإن حاجوك فقل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن اتبعن﴾: the wāw is for conjunction, or for accompaniment; من is a relative noun conjoined to the tāʾ in أسلمت, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); and the clause اتبعن is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقل للذين أوتوا الكتاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قل is an imperative verb; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قل; أوتوا is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause أوتوا الكتاب is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿والأميين﴾: conjoined to أوتوا الكتاب, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.
﴿أأسلمتم﴾: the interrogative clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying.
﴿فإن أسلموا فقد اهتدوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. إن is conditional; أسلموا is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ connects the apodosis; قد is a particle of confirmation; اهتدوا is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause joined [to the fāʾ] is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وإن تولوا﴾: the clause is conjoined to the first clause.
﴿فإنما عليك البلاغ﴾: إنما is (inna) restrained by mā (kāffa wa-makfūfa); عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); البلاغ is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿والله بصير بالعباد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, بصير is the khabar, and بالعباد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بصير.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿إن الذين يكفرون بآيات الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); الذين is its noun; the clause يكفرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يكفرون.
﴿ويقتلون النبيين بغير حق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يقتلون is an imperfect verb conjoined to يكفرون; النبيين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the yāʾ; and بغير حق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being wrongdoers".
﴿ويقتلون الذين يأمرون بالقسط من الناس﴾: conjoined to what precedes; من الناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "being of them".
﴿فبشرهم بعذاب أليم﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of the relative noun, because of the hint of condition in it; بشرهم is an imperative verb, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you"; بعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بشرهم; أليم is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause joined to the fāʾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿أولئك الذين حبطت أعمالهم في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: the clause is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾ in the previous ayah. أولئك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and الذين is the khabar. The clause ﴿حبطت أعمالهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿في الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حبطت﴾, and الآخرة is conjoined to ﴿الدنيا﴾.
﴿وما لهم من ناصرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and ناصرين is genitive in form and nominative in position, because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا إن تطيعوا فريقا من الذين أوتوا الكتاب﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle for the intermediately distant addressee; أي is a munādā (the one addressed), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for alerting; الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تطيعوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, because it is one of the Five Verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); فريقًا is [a direct object] [Translator's note: the source reads «وفريقًا به», with the word مفعول evidently missing]; من الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of His word فريقًا; the clause أوتوا الكتاب is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the passive أوتوا.
﴿يردوكم بعد إيمانكم كافرين﴾: يردوكم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the Five Verbs; the wāw is the agent; the kāf is the first direct object of يردوكم; بعد إيمانكم is an adverb attached to كافرين; and كافرين is the second direct object.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿وكيف تكفرون وأنتم تتلى عليكم آيات الله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; كيف is an interrogative noun of rebuke, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); تكفرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); وأنتم: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنتم is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); تتلى is an imperfect verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), and the clause is the khabar (predicate); عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتلى; and آيات الله is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿وفيكم رسوله﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or a conjunction; فيكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; and رسوله is the delayed mubtadaʾ.
﴿ومن يعتصم بالله فقد هدي إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; يعتصم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he"; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعتصم; فقد: the fāʾ links the answer, and قد is a particle of realization; هدي is a past verb, passive, and its deputy agent is "he"; إلى صراط is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هدي; مستقيم is an adjective (ṣifa); the clause فقد هدي is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis with its apodosis is the khabar of من. The clause ﴿ومن يعتصم بالله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله حق تقاته﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle; أي is a munādā (the one addressed), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for alerting; الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾. آمنوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; اتقوا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the agent; the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and حق تقاته is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿ولا تموتن إلا وأنتم مسلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تموتن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, because it is one of the Five Verbs; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative as agent; the doubled nūn is for emphasis and has no grammatical position; إلا is a particle of restriction; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and مسلمون the khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿واعتصموا بحبل الله جميعا ولا تفرقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اعتصموا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); بحبل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اعتصموا; جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); لا is prohibitive; تفرقوا is an imperfect verb, one of whose two tāʾs has been optionally dropped, its original being تتفرقوا, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn.
﴿واذكروا نعمت الله عليكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اذكروا is an imperative verb conjoined to اعتصموا; نعمة الله is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar, i.e. "remember His bestowing [favour] upon you", or attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His favour, being upon you".
﴿إذ كنتم أعداء فألف بين قلوبكم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for ﴿نعمة الله﴾, on the assumption that ﴿نعمة﴾ is taken as a maṣdar, or a noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of an accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from ﴿نعمة الله﴾; the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation to it; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun and أعداء its khabar (predicate); the fāʾ is a conjunction; ألف is a past verb whose agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to Allah; بين is an adverb attached to ألف; and قلوبكم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فأصبحتم بنعمته إخوانا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أصبحتم is a defective past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; بنعمته is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and إخوانًا is the khabar of أصبحتم.
﴿وكنتم على شفا حفرة من النار فأنقذكم منها﴾: conjoined to what precedes; كنتم is a defective past verb and the tāʾ is its noun; على شفا حفرة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; من النار is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of حفرة; فأنقذكم is conjoined to كنتم; and منها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنقذكم.
﴿كذلك يبين الله لكم آياته لعلكم تهتدون﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar placed before its governing word, i.e. "with an explaining like that does Allah explain His signs to you"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يبين﴾ is an imperfect verb and ﴿الله﴾ the agent; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبين﴾; ﴿آياته﴾ is a direct object; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لعلكم﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the kāf its noun; the clause ﴿تهتدون﴾ is the khabar of لعل; and the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿ولتكن منكم أمة يدعون إلى الخير﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, the wāw being a conjunction; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām is the lām of command; تكن is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of تكن; أمة is its delayed noun; and the clause يدعون إلى الخير is in the position of a nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of أمة; it is also said: the clause يدعون is the khabar, and منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إلى الخير is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يدعون.
﴿ويأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر﴾: the two clauses are conjoined to the clause يدعون إلى الخير.
﴿وأولئك هم﴾: أولئك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.
﴿المفلحون﴾: the khabar of أولئك; or: هم is a mubtadaʾ and المفلحون its khabar, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿ولا تكونوا كالذين تفرقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تكونوا is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is its noun; ﴿كالذين﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا; ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause تفرقوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿واختلفوا من بعد ما جاءهم البينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اختلفوا is conjoined to تفرقوا; من بعد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اختلفوا; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ with ﴿جاءهم البينات﴾ is genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and البينات is the delayed fāʿil (agent).
﴿وأولئك لهم عذاب عظيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or [the wāw is] a conjunction; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; عذاب is the delayed mubtadaʾ and عظيم an adjective (ṣifa); and the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the demonstrative.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
