﴿يوم تبيض وجوه وتسود وجوه﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] settledness contained in the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لهم﴾ in the previous verse, the implied sense being "and those, for them is settled a punishment on the day when [faces] turn white"; or ﴿يوم﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, so the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, the implied sense being "remember the day when [faces] turn white…" etc.; the clause ﴿تبيض وجوه﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). وجوه is the fāʿil (agent), and تسود وجوه is conjoined to تبيض وجوه.
﴿فأما الذين اسودت وجوههم﴾: the fāʾ is for ramification (tafrīʿ) and carries the sense of resumption, so the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أما is a particle of condition and detailing; الذين is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿اسودت وجوههم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿أكفرتم بعد إيمانكم﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted verb of saying, together with the fāʾ that links the apodosis of أما, i.e. "it will be said to them: did you disbelieve"; the clause ﴿فيقال﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of الذين and it is the answer of ﴿أما﴾; the hamza is for interrogation of rebuke and reproach; كفرتم is a verb and its agent; بعد is an adverb attached to كفرتم; and إيمانكم is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it discloses what is implied, i.e. "if you have known that, then taste the punishment"; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ذوقوا; ما is maṣdar-forming, and it together with what it enters upon is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of your disbelieving"; and the clause تكفرون is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿وأما الذين ابيضت وجوههم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أما is a particle of condition and detailing; الذين is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿ابيضت وجوههم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿ففي رحمة الله هم فيها خالدون﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of أما; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of الذين; هم is a mubtadaʾ; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خالدون﴾; خالدون is the khabar of هم; and the clause ﴿هم فيها خالدون﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿تلك آيات الله نتلوها عليك بالحق﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and آيات الله its khabar (predicate); the clause نتلوها عليك is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), i.e. "bound up with the truth", so the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وما الله يريد ظلما للعالمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating ما, which operates like ليس; the Name of Majesty is the noun of ما, and the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of ما; or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-operative negating particle, the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿ظلمًا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للعالمين: the lām is a preposition and العالمين is a noun, genitive with the yāʾ in place of the kasra, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ظلمًا﴾. The clause ﴿وما الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun, the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); في السماوات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, which has no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿ولله ما في السماوات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ما في الأرض is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾.
﴿وإلى الله ترجع الأمور﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ترجع; ترجع is an imperfect verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named); and الأمور is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿كنتم خير أمة أخرجت للناس﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the tāʾ is its noun and خير أمة its khabar (predicate); it is also said: كان is complete (tāmma), i.e. "you have been found and created as the best community"; أخرجت is a past verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هي); للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرجت; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a second khabar of كنتم; it is also said: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and it is also said: a naʿt (adjective) of أمة.
﴿تأمرون بالمعروف وتنهون عن المنكر﴾: the clause is a third khabar of ﴿كنتم﴾, or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, or in the position of an accusative as a naʿt of ﴿خير أمة﴾. تأمرون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). بالمعروف: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تأمرون﴾. ﴿وتنهون عن المنكر﴾: conjoined to ﴿تأمرون بالمعروف﴾.
﴿وتؤمنون بالله﴾: the clause is conjoined.
﴿ولو آمن أهل الكتاب لكان خيرا لهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; آمن is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; أهل الكتاب is the agent; the lām occurs in the answer of لو; كان is a defective past verb whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it", referring to the maṣdar, namely the believing indicated by its verb; خيرًا is the khabar of كان; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خيرًا﴾; and the clause occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿منهم المؤمنون وأكثرهم الفاسقون﴾: منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and المؤمنون is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); أكثرهم is a mubtadaʾ and الفاسقون its khabar. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ألم تر إلى الذين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The hamza is for the interrogative of wonder; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تر is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you"; إلى الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تر﴾.
﴿أوتوا﴾: a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ has no grammatical position.
﴿نصيبًا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من الكتاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نصيبًا﴾.
﴿يدعون إلى كتاب الله﴾: the clause يدعون is circumstantial (ḥāl); يدعون is an imperfect verb in the passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; إلى كتاب الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يدعون.
﴿ليحكم﴾: the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); يحكم is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied أن after the causal lām; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the causal lām; and the causal lām with its genitive is attached to يدعون.
﴿بينهم﴾: an adverb of place attached to يحكم.
﴿ثم يتولى فريق منهم﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting sequence with delay; يتولى is a nominative imperfect verb; الفريق is the fāʿil; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt. [Translator's note: the source writes «الفريق» with the article; the ayah has ﴿فريق﴾.]
﴿وهم معرضون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and معرضون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿ذلك بأنهم قالوا﴾: ذلك is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. بأنهم: the bāʾ is a preposition; أن together with what it governs is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), i.e. "that turning away is because of their saying"; and the clause قالوا is the khabar of أن.
﴿لن تمسنا النار إلا أياما معدودات﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). لن is a particle of negation, of the subjunctive (naṣb) and of the future; تمسنا is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by لن; ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); النار is the fāʿil (agent) of تمسنا; إلا is a particle of restriction; أيامًا is an adverb attached to تمسنا; and معدودات is a naʿt (adjective), the sign of its accusative being the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿وغرهم في دينهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; غرهم is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi; and في دينهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غرهم.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
﴿كانوا يفترون﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun; and the clause يفترون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿فكيف إذا جمعناهم﴾: the fāʾ attached to كيف is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position. كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as a fronted khabar (predicate), the mubtadaʾ (subject) being omitted, its implied form being "their state"; إذا is an adverb devoid of the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied mubtadaʾ, the implied wording being "so how will their state be at the time of Our gathering them?". جمعناهم is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿جمعناهم﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿ليوم لا ريب فيه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جمعناهم; لا is the lā of generic negation; ريب is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative; فيه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; and the clause ﴿لا ريب فيه﴾ is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of يوم.
﴿ووفيت كل نفس ما كسبت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; وفيت is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); كل نفس is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause كسبت is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a mubtadaʾ; لا is negative; يظلمون is an imperfect verb in the passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يظلمون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of هم; and the nominal clause joined to the wāw is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قل اللهم مالك الملك﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. قل is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you"; اللهم is a munādā (one addressed), a singular proper name, the doubled mīm being a substitute for ﴿يا﴾ with no grammatical position; and مالك is a second munādā from which the vocative particle has been omitted.
﴿تؤتي الملك من تشاء﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the munādā, because it stands in the place of a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); تؤتي is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "You". الملك is the first mafʿūl bihi; من is a relative noun, the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause تشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿وتعز من تشاء وتذل من تشاء﴾: also conjoined.
﴿بيدك الخير﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and الخير is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿إنك على كل شيء قدير﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, serving as a statement of reason for what precedes.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿تولج الليل في النهار﴾: the clause is also a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وتولج النهار في الليل﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿وتخرج الحي من الميت وتخرج الميت من الحي﴾: also conjoined.
﴿وترزق من تشاء بغير حساب﴾: also conjoined; من is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause تشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of ترزق.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿لا يتخذ المؤمنون الكافرين أولياء من دون المؤمنين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. لا is prohibitive; يتخذ is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا; المؤمنون is the fāʿil (agent); الكافرين is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and أولياء is the second mafʿūl bihi; من دون المؤمنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil, i.e. "the believers being such as pass beyond the alliance of the believers", or of the object, i.e. "the disbelievers being helpers apart from the believers".
﴿ومن يفعل ذلك فليس من الله في شيء﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and the whole clause is parenthetical with no grammatical position. من is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); يفعل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), in the jussive; ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to ﴿من﴾. من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and في شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ليس.
﴿إلا أن تتقوا منهم تقاة﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction; أن with what falls within its scope is a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تتقوا﴾. ﴿تقاة﴾ stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), in the accusative; it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being اتقاء. Or it is a mafʿūl bihi, ﴿تتقوا﴾ being made to include the sense of fear, i.e. "unless you fear from their side something that must be guarded against". [Translator's note: the source writes «وإن وما في حيزها», evidently for أن.]
﴿ويحذركم الله نفسه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يحذركم is an imperfect verb, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; and نفسه is the second mafʿūl bihi of يحذركم. The clause ﴿ويحذركم الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإلى الله المصير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and المصير is a postponed mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿وإلى الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿قل إن تخفوا ما في صدوركم أو تبدوه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. قل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you"; إن is conditional; تخفوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive (majzūm) being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في صدوركم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction, and ﴿تبدوه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تخفوا﴾.
﴿يعلمه الله﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; and the clause of condition and apodosis is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ويعلم ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يعلم is a nominative imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is "He", referring to the Name of Majesty; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; في السماوات is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ما في الأرض is conjoined; and the clause ﴿ويعلم ما في السماوات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. It has also been said: the clause ﴿يعلم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being "and He knows".
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; على كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدير; and قدير is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿يوم تجد كل نفس ما عملت من خير محضرا﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تود﴾, or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) in the accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (sing. or pl.); the clause تجد is in the position of the genitive by annexation; تجد is an imperfect verb; كل نفس is the fāʿil (agent); ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; the clause عملت is the ṣila (relative clause), the returning pronoun being omitted, i.e. "it did it", and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; من خير is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); محضرًا is a ḥāl; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. It has also been said: تجد takes two objects, the first being the relative ما and the second محضرا.
﴿وما عملت من سوء﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause عملت is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and من سوء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause ﴿وما عملت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿تود لو أن بينها وبينه أمدا بعيدا﴾: the clause تود is the khabar (predicate) of ما; لو is a non-jussive conditional; أن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); بينها is an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar of ﴿أن﴾, and بينه is conjoined to the adverb. The apodosis of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, its implied form being "it would rejoice and be at ease"; أن with what follows it is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "established", or as the fāʿil of an omitted [verb], its implied form being "it were established"; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb تود.
﴿ويحذركم الله نفسه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; يحذركم is an imperfect verb, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; and نفسه is the second mafʿūl bihi of يحذركم. The clause ﴿ويحذركم الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله رءوف بالعباد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, and رءوف is its khabar; بالعباد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رءوف. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿قل إن كنتم تحبون الله فاتبعوني﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. قل is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you"; إن is conditional; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun; and the clause تحبون الله is its khabar (predicate).
﴿فاتبعوني﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); اتبعوني is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the clause إن كنتم is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿يحببكم﴾: the reply to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), in the jussive; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿الله﴾: the fāʿil.
﴿ويغفر لكم ذنوبكم﴾: conjoined to يحببكم.
﴿والله غفور رحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); and غفور رحيم are two khabars of the mubtadaʾ. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿قل أطيعوا الله والرسول﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. أطيعوا is an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause أطيعوا is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and الرسول is conjoined to the Name of Majesty, in the accusative.
﴿فإن تولوا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; تولوا is an imperfect verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the clause having no grammatical position; or it is a past verb ascribed to the third-person pronoun, the clause being in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis.
﴿فإن الله لا يحب الكافرين﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause لا يحب الكافرين is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿فإن الله﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿فإن تولوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:179-179.t:
﴿ما كان الله ليذر المؤمنين﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; ما is negating; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); ليذر: the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and يذر is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن necessarily implied (muqaddara) after the genitive-governing lām of denial; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان, the implied sense being: "Allah was not one to want to leave them in a state of mixture and confusion"; ﴿المؤمنين﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿على ما أنتم عليه﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يذر﴾; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and عليه its khabar; the clause ﴿أنتم عليه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿حتى يميز الخبيث من الطيب﴾: ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of terminus (ghāya) and a preposition; يميز is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after ﴿حتى﴾; أن and the verb are interpreted as a genitive maṣdar (verbal noun), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar, i.e. "wanting to leave them"; الخبيث is a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من الطيب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يميز.
﴿وما كان الله ليطلعكم على الغيب﴾: resumptive speech, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; كان is a defective past verb; the Name of Majesty is its noun; ليطلعكم: the lām is the lām of denial, and يطلعكم is an imperfect verb, accusative by أن necessarily implied after the genitive-governing lām of denial, with a mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (huwa). ﴿على الغيب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يطلع﴾.
﴿ولكن الله يجتبي من رسله من يشاء﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لكن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle in the meaning of rectification (istidrāk); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause ﴿يجتبي﴾ is its khabar; ﴿من رسله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجتبي﴾; ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فآمنوا بالله ورسله﴾: the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; آمنوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنوا; رسله is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of a non-jussive condition, namely the one in whose answer the fāʾ occurred.
﴿وإن تؤمنوا وتتقوا فلكم أجر عظيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تؤمنوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); تتقوا is conjoined to تؤمنوا; ﴿فلكم﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; أجر is a postponed mubtadaʾ; عظيم is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis.

muyesser-irab:180-180.t:
﴿ولا يحسبن الذين يبخلون﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; or: the wāw is conjunctive and the speech is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive (nāhiya); ﴿يحسبن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by لا; الذين is a relative verb, fāʿil (agent) [Translator's note: the source has «فعل موصول» ("relative verb"), evidently for «اسم موصول» ("relative noun")]; the clause ﴿يبخلون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿بما آتاهم الله من فضله هو خيرا لهم﴾: بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبخلون﴾; the clause ﴿آتاهم الله﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿من فضله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آتاهم﴾; the first object of ﴿يحسبن﴾ is omitted, the context of the speech indicating it, i.e. "stinginess"; ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; خيرًا is the second object of يحسبن; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خير.
﴿بل هو شر لهم﴾: ﴿بل﴾ is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); شر is the khabar (predicate); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿شر﴾.
﴿سيطوقون ما بخلوا به يوم القيامة﴾: the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya) of His saying هو شر لهم, or causal and resumptive, and on both views it has no grammatical position. The sīn is a particle of futurity conveying emphasis; يطوقون is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "with what they withheld." ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بخلوا﴾; ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿يطوقون﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ولله ميراث السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿ميراث السماوات﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; الأرض is conjoined to السماوات.
﴿والله بما تعملون خبير﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خبير; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; خبير is the khabar; and the clause ﴿والله بما تعملون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:181-181.t:
﴿لقد سمع الله قول الذين قالوا﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); سمع is a past verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); قول is its object; الذين is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن الله فقير ونحن أغنياء﴾: the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); ﴿فقير﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿ونحن﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject); أغنياء is the khabar; and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it.
﴿سنكتب ما قالوا﴾: the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the sīn is a particle of futurity; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of نكتب; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, i.e. "their saying," and the clause is the ṣila of the relative [particle], with no grammatical position.
﴿وقتلهم الأنبياء بغير حق﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قتل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما﴾, or to the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun); the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by iḍāfa; الأنبياء is the mafʿūl bihi of the maṣdar, which is القتل; ﴿بغير حق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [word] in the place of an accusative (naṣb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ونقول ذوقوا عذاب الحريق﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the clause ﴿ذوقوا﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of saying; ﴿عذاب الحريق﴾ is the object of ﴿ذوقوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:182-182.t:
﴿ذلك بما قدمت أيديكم﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿قدمت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; أيديكم is the fāʿil (agent) of قدمت.
﴿وأن الله ليس بظلام للعبيد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause ليس is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of أن; the noun of ليس is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; ﴿بظلام﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and ظلام is the khabar of ليس, accusative (manṣūb) in position, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ in form; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أنّ﴾ and what is in its scope is genitive, conjoined to the relative ﴿ما﴾ in His saying (Exalted is He) ﴿بما قدمت﴾. And it was said: the wāw is resumptive, and His saying ﴿أنّ الله ليس بظلام للعبيد﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "and the matter is that Allah ... etc."

muyesser-irab:183-183.t:
﴿الذين قالوا إن الله عهد إلينا﴾: الذين is a badal (substitute) of the preceding relative noun in His saying ﴿لقد سمع الله قول الذين﴾, or a naʿt (adjective) of it, or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause being resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿إن الله... etc.﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿عهد﴾ is its khabar; ﴿إلينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عهد.
﴿ألا نؤمن لرسول﴾: the maṣdariyya أن and what is in its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "He commanded us in the Torah that we not believe a messenger"; ﴿لرسول﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نؤمن﴾.
﴿حتى يأتينا بقربان تأكله النار﴾: حتى is a particle of terminus (ghāya) and a preposition; ﴿يأتينا﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after حتى; أن and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نؤمن; ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بقربان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتينا﴾; the clause ﴿تأكله النار﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of قربان.
﴿قل قد جاءكم رسل من قبلي﴾: the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position; قل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "you" (anta); the clause ﴿قد جاءكم﴾ is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying; رسل is the fāʿil; ﴿من قبلي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of رسل.
﴿بالبينات وبالذي قلتم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جاءكم﴾; ﴿وبالذي﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to His saying بالبينات; the clause ﴿قلتم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلم قتلتموهم إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; the lām is a preposition, and the interrogative ما, with its alif omitted, is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to قتلتموهم; ﴿قتلتموهم﴾ is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ) the vowel of the mīm; إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the noun of كان, and صادقين its khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "then why did you kill them?"

muyesser-irab:184-184.t:
﴿فإن كذبوك فقد كذب رسل من قبلك﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the speech after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; كذبوك is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); فقد: the fāʾ links the answer, and قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); كذب is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); رسل is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من قبلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رسل.
﴿جاءوا بالبينات والزبر والكتاب المنير﴾: the clause is an adjective of رسل; بالبينات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاءوا; what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to it; المنير is an adjective of الكتاب.

muyesser-irab:185-185.t:
﴿كل نفس ذائقة الموت﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿كل نفس﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ذائقة الموت﴾ its khabar (predicate).
﴿وإنما توفون أجوركم يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿إنما﴾ is a restraining [ما] and a restrained [إن] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ﴿توفون﴾ is an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿أجوركم﴾ is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿توفون﴾.
﴿فمن زحزح عن النار وأدخل الجنة فقد فاز﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿من﴾ is a jussive-making conditional noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) mubtadaʾ; ﴿زحزح﴾ is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it is built for that whose agent is not named, its nāʾib fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (huwa); ﴿عن النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿زحزح﴾; ﴿أدخل﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿زحزح﴾, its nāʾib fāʿil being latent; ﴿الجنة﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq); فاز is a past verb, and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿وما الحياة الدنيا إلا متاع الغرور﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; الحياة is the mubtadaʾ; الدنيا is an adjective (ṣifa); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); متاع الغرور is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:186-186.t:
﴿لتبلون في أموالكم وأنفسكم﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; ﴿تبلون﴾ is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, the sign of its being nominative being the retention of the nūn, [which is] omitted because of the succession of similar [letters]; the wāw of the group, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent); the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; ﴿في أموالكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبلون﴾; ﴿وأنفسكم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿أموالكم﴾; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to an implied oath, and the oath clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.
﴿ولتسمعن من الذين أوتوا الكتاب من قبلكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath; ﴿تسمعن﴾ is a nominative imperfect verb, the sign of its being nominative being the retention of the nūn, omitted because of the succession of similar [letters]; the wāw of the group, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; من الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تسمعن; the clause ﴿أوتوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the wāw in ﴿أوتوا﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿الكتاب﴾ is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من قبلكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ومن الذين أشركوا أذى كثيرا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; من الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to ﴿من الذين أوتوا الكتاب﴾, and they are attached to ﴿تسمعن﴾; أذى is the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تسمعن﴾; كثيرًا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿وإن تصبروا وتتقوا فإن ذلك من عزم الأمور﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is conditional; تصبروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); تتقوا is conjoined to ﴿تصبروا﴾; فإن: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ذلك is its noun (ism); ﴿من عزم الأمور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause joined with the fāʾ has no grammatical position, because it stands as a cause for the omitted apodosis, occurring in its place, the implied form being: "and if you are patient and fear [Allah], it is better for you"; or: the clause joined with the fāʾ is the answer.

muyesser-irab:187-187.t:
﴿وإذ أخذ الله ميثاق الذين أوتوا الكتاب﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember," i.e. "remember the time when Allah took the covenant." ﴿أخذ الله﴾: [أخذ] is a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿ميثاق﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أخذ﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿أوتوا الكتاب﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and الكتاب is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لتبيننه للناس ولا تكتمونه﴾: the lām is the answer to the oath indicated by the taking of the covenant, as though He said to them: "By Allah, you shall make it clear"; تبيننه is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, the sign of its being nominative being the retention of the nūn, omitted because of the succession of similar [letters]; للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبيننه﴾; ولا تكتمونه: the wāw is conjunctive, and تكتمونه is a clause conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to ﴿تبيننه﴾; or: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فنبذوه وراء ظهورهم﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ﴿نبذوه﴾ is a verb, a fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿وراء ظهورهم﴾ is accusative as a second object; and it was said: an adverb.
﴿واشتروا به ثمنا قليلا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; اشتروا is conjoined to ﴿نبذوه﴾; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اشتروا; ثمنًا is a mafʿūl bihi; قليلًا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فبئس ما يشترون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; بئس is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); ﴿ما﴾ is a complete (tāmma) indefinite noun, accusative as a tamyīz (specification); or it is maṣdariyya, interpreted with the verb as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is the fāʿil, i.e. "their purchase." The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "this"; and the clause ﴿فبئس ما يشترون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:188-188.t:
﴿لا تحسبن الذين يفرحون بما أتوا﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تحسبن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its being attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by لا; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (anta); الذين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يفرحون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يفرحون; and the clause أتوا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿ويحبون أن يحمدوا بما لم يفعلوا﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿يحبون﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿يفرحون﴾; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن﴾ and what is in its scope is an accusative mafʿūl bihi; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يحمدوا﴾; ﴿لم﴾ is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and making jussive; يفعلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the nūn; and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلا تحسبنهم بمفازة من العذاب﴾: the fāʾ is connective (ṣila), for embellishing the wording; بمفازة is a preposition and its genitive noun, in the place of the second object of ﴿تحسبنهم﴾; ﴿من العذاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿مفازة﴾ if ﴿مفازة﴾ is taken as a noun of place, or attached to ﴿مفازة﴾ if it is taken as a mīmī maṣdar.
﴿ولهم عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); عذاب is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); أليم is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:189-189.t:
﴿ولله ملك السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ملك is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); السماوات is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الأرض is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿السماوات﴾.
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿على كل شيء﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير; قدير is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:190-190.t:
﴿إن في خلق السماوات والأرض﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿في خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿واختلاف الليل والنهار﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿خلق﴾.
﴿لآيات لأولي الألباب﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is the postponed noun (ism) of إن; ﴿لأولي الألباب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of آيات.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿لن يضروكم إلا أذى﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; لن is a particle of negation, accusative-governing and future; يضروكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, because it is one of the Five Verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). إلا is a particle of restriction. أذى: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it has the meaning of the maṣdar. The exception is emptied (mufarragh); it is also said: the exception here is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ).
﴿وإن يقاتلوكم يولوكم الأدبار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يقاتلوكم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the agent; the kāf is the first direct object; and الأدبار is the second object.
﴿ثم لا ينصرون﴾: ثم is a particle of conjunction and delay; لا is negating; ينصرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:112-112.t:
﴿ضربت عليهم الذلة أين ما ثقفوا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ضربت is a past verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), the tāʾ being for the feminine; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ضربت; الذلة is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أينما is a jussivizing conditional noun, accusative as an adverb of place, attached to ضربت; ثقفوا is a past verb, passive, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the deputy agent; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then [humiliation] has been laid upon them".
﴿إلا بحبل من الله﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative as excepted from the most general of states, so it is an excepted [element] with the meaning of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "humiliation has been laid upon them in all their states except in this state, namely their holding fast to a rope from Allah"; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa); on this view it is a joined (muttaṣil) exception, and it is also said: it is disjoined (munqaṭiʿ).
﴿وحبل من الناس﴾: conjoined to His saying: بحبل من الله.
﴿وباءوا بغضب من الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; باءوا is a conjoined past verb and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to the clause ضربت; بغضب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to باءوا; and من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of غضب.
﴿وضربت عليهم المسكنة﴾: conjoined to what precedes; عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضربت; المسكنة is the deputy agent of ضربت; and the clause was repeated to emphasize the humiliation laid upon the Jews.
﴿ذلك بأنهم كانوا يكفرون بآيات الله﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the reference being to what was mentioned of the laying of humiliation and wretchedness and the anger of Allah; بأنهم: the bāʾ is a preposition, أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the hāʾ is its noun; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and what falls in its scope is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿أنهم﴾; the clause يكفرون is in the position of an accusative as the khabar of كانوا; and ﴿بآيات الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكفرون.
﴿ويقتلون الأنبياء بغير حق﴾: conjoined to what precedes; الأنبياء is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and بغير حق is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ذلك بما عصوا وكانوا يعتدون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdar-forming, i.e. "because of their disobedience", so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿ذلك﴾; ﴿كانوا﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb; the wāw is its noun; and the clause يعتدون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿ليسوا سواء﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ليس is an abrogating past verb, the wāw is its noun and ﴿سواء﴾ its khabar (predicate).
﴿من أهل الكتاب أمة قائمة﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; أمة is the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); and قائمة is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿يتلون آيات الله آناء الليل وهم يسجدون﴾: the clause يتلون is a second adjective of أمة; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) of يتلون; آيات الله is its object; آناء الليل is an adverb of time attached to يتلون; وهم: the wāw is for the ḥāl, هم is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause يسجدون is in the position of a nominative as the khabar.

muyesser-irab:114-114.t:
﴿يؤمنون بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: the clause is a third adjective (ṣifa) of أمة; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤمنون; اليوم is conjoined to the Name of Majesty; and الآخر is an adjective of اليوم.
﴿ويأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر ويسارعون في الخيرات﴾: three clauses conjoined to the clause يؤمنون بالله.
﴿وأولئك من الصالحين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:115-115.t:
﴿وما يفعلوا من خير فلن يكفروه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is conditional, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يفعلوا; يفعلوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ; لن is an accusative-governing particle; يكفروه is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the hāʾ is the second direct object; the clause ﴿فلن يكفروه﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله عليم بالمتقين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and عليم its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:116-116.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا لن تغني عنهم أموالهم ولا أولادهم من الله شيئا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذين is its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; لن is an accusative-governing particle; تغني is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تغني; أموالهم is the fāʿil (agent); ولا أولادهم is conjoined to ﴿أموالهم﴾; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شيئًا﴾ and was placed before it; شيئًا is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause لن تغني is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿وأولئك أصحاب النار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and أصحاب النار is its khabar; the clause is conjoined to the clause لن تغني.
﴿هم فيها خالدون﴾: هم is a mubtadaʾ; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to His word خالدون; خالدون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause is a second khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿مثل ما ينفقون في هذه الحياة الدنيا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; مثل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ما is a relative noun in the position of a genitive by annexation; the clause ينفقون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; في هذه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون; الحياة is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; and الدنيا is an adjective (ṣifa) of الحياة.
﴿كمثل ريح فيها صر﴾: ﴿كمثل﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مِثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; مَثَل is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ريح is muḍāf ilayhi; فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; صر is the delayed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿فيها صر﴾ is an adjective of ﴿ريح﴾.
﴿أصابت حرث قوم ظلموا أنفسهم فأهلكته﴾: the clause أصابت is a second adjective of ريح; حرث قوم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أصابت; the clause ظلموا is in the position of a genitive as an adjective of قوم; أنفسهم is the direct object of ظلموا; and فأهلكته is conjoined to أصابت.
﴿وما ظلمهم الله ولكن أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating; ظلمهم الله is a verb, a fronted direct object and a delayed fāʿil (agent); لكن is lightened from the heavy form, inoperative, for rectification (istidrāk); أنفسهم is a fronted direct object of يظلمون; يظلمون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. The clause ﴿وما ظلمهم الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:118-118.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿يا أيها﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is a munādā (the one addressed), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for alerting. الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾. ﴿آمنوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تتخذوا بطانة من دونكم﴾: لا is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the agent; بطانة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من دونكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of بطانة; and the second object of تتخذوا is omitted for concision, its implied form being "intimates" or "allies". Or: [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to تتخذوا, and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the place of the second object of تتخذوا.
﴿لا يألونكم خبالا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; it is also said: it is a second adjective of بطانة; لا is negating; يألونكم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the agent; the kāf is the first direct object and خبالًا the second direct object. Or the verb is intransitive and the kāf is in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "they do not spare [effort] for you", and خبالًا is likewise accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in corruption", or accusative as a tamyīz (specification), or as a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ودوا ما عنتم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, like the one before it; it is also said: it is a third adjective of بطانة, and both are correct; ودوا is a verb and its agent; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾ with what falls in its scope is a direct object.
﴿قد بدت البغضاء من أفواههم﴾: the clause is also resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it is a fourth adjective of بطانة; قد is a particle of realization; بدت is a past [verb], indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; البغضاء is the agent; من أفواههم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بدت; and it is also said: attached to an omitted [element], accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿وما تخفي صدورهم أكبر﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl or for resumption, and the clause is circumstantial, or resumptive with no grammatical position; ما is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause تخفي is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; صدورهم is the agent of تخفي; and أكبر is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿قد بينا لكم الآيات إن كنتم تعقلون﴾: قد is a particle of realization; بينا is a past verb and its agent; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بينا; الآيات is a direct object; and the clause ﴿قد بينا لكم الآيات﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is the noun of كنتم; the clause تعقلون is the khabar of كنتم; and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then do not ever befriend them".

muyesser-irab:119-119.t:
﴿ها أنتم أولاء تحبونهم ولا يحبونكم﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; ها is for alerting; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and أولاء its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿تحبونهم﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or resumptive with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿ولا يحبونكم﴾ is conjoined to the clause تحبونهم; it is also said: أولاء is a munādā (the one addressed), i.e. "O these", so that the clause ﴿تحبونهم﴾ is the khabar.
﴿وتؤمنون بالكتاب كله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿تحبونهم﴾; or: the wāw is circumstantial and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); بالكتاب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تؤمنون; كله is a tawkīd (emphasis) of الكتاب; and it is also said: the wāw is circumstantial.
﴿وإذا لقوكم قالوا آمنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is an adverb for future time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿لقوكم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition; and the clause ﴿آمنا﴾ is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech). The clause ﴿وإذا لقوكم قالوا آمنا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإذا خلوا عضوا عليكم الأنامل من الغيظ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذا is an adverb for future time; the clause ﴿خلوا﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; خلا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of a nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause عضوا has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عضوا; الأنامل is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and من الغيظ is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of an accusative as a tamyīz (specification), i.e. "in rage"; it is also said: من has the meaning of the lām and so conveys cause, so the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "because of rage".
﴿قل موتوا بغيظكم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿موتوا﴾ is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl; and بغيظكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [element], accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "bound up with your rage".
﴿إن الله عليم بذات الصدور﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; it is also said: the clause is part of what is said, so it is in the position of an accusative by the [verb of] saying; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun and ﴿عليم﴾ its khabar; and بذات الصدور: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليم.

muyesser-irab:120-120.t:
﴿إن تمسسكم حسنة تسؤهم﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; تمسسكم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); the kāf is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and حسنة the delayed fāʿil (agent); تسؤهم is the jussive apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is a direct object.
﴿وإن تصبكم سيئة يفرحوا بها﴾: a clause conjoined to the preceding clause.
﴿وإن تصبروا وتتقوا لا يضركم كيدهم شيئا﴾: the clause is also conjoined; إن is conditional; تصبروا is the protasis, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; تتقوا is conjoined to تصبروا; لا is negating; يضركم is the apodosis, vowelled with ḍamma to follow the ḍamma of the ḍād; the kāf is a direct object; كيدهم is the agent; and شيئًا is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "anything of harm".
﴿إن الله بما يعملون محيط﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Name of Majesty is its noun and محيط its khabar (predicate); بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) محيط; and the clause يعملون has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:121-121.t:
﴿وإذ غدوت من أهلك تبوئ المؤمنين مقاعد للقتال﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember"; the clause ﴿غدوت﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) of غدوت; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) غدوت; and the clause تبوئ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) from the agent of غدوت. Or the tāʾ is the noun of غدا, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause تبوئ is the khabar (predicate) of غدوت. المؤمنين is the direct object of تبوئ; مقاعد is the second direct object of تبوئ; and للقتال is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of مقاعد, i.e. "positions prepared for fighting". The clause ﴿وإذ غدوت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والله سميع عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and سميع عليم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:122-122.t:
﴿إذ همت طائفتان منكم أن تفشلا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as a badal (substitute) from the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in the saying of the Exalted ﴿وإذ غدوت﴾, or an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبوىء﴾ or to ﴿غدوت﴾ or to ﴿سميع عليم﴾; the clause ﴿همت﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation; طائفتان is the fāʿil (agent) of همت; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of His word ﴿طائفتان﴾; أن is a maṣdar-forming, accusative-governing particle; تفشلا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, because it is one of the Five Verbs; the alif of the dual is the agent; and أن with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to همت, because it takes its object through the bāʾ, the implied form being "to lose heart" (بأن تفشلا).
﴿والله وليهما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and وليهما the khabar (predicate).
﴿وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتوكل; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it has entered for the sense of condition, the meaning being "when matters press and become hard, then rely [on Allah]"; and المؤمنون is the agent.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿إن الله اصطفى آدم ونوحا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); the Name of Majesty is its noun; and the clause اصطفى آدم ونوحًا is the khabar (predicate).
﴿وآل إبراهيم وآل عمران﴾: conjoined to آدم.
﴿على العالمين﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اصطفى; and the clause ﴿إن الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ذرية بعضها من بعض﴾: ذرية is a badal (substitute) for آدم and what is conjoined to it, or for آل إبراهيم and آل عمران, i.e. the two families are one line of descent. Or it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), the governing word (ʿāmil) being ﴿اصطفى﴾. بعضها is a mubtadaʾ (subject); من بعض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of ذرية.
﴿والله سميع عليم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, and سميع عليم are two khabars of it.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿إذ قالت امرأت عمران﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember", i.e. "remember to them the time of her saying"; the clause ﴿قالت امرأة عمران﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿رب إني نذرت لك ما في بطني محررا﴾: رب is a munādā (one addressed) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause نذرت is its khabar (predicate); the clause إني نذرت is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نذرت; ما is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿في بطني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. محررًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿فتقبل مني﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; تقبل is a verb of supplication, and its fāʿil (agent) is "You"; مني is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقبل. The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنك أنت السميع العليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the kāf is its noun; أنت is a mubtadaʾ (subject), or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; السميع العليم are two khabars of أنت; the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾; and the clause of إن with what falls within its scope is causal, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿فلما وضعتها قالت رب إني وضعتها أنثى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it has no grammatical position. لما is an adverb of time ("when"), or a particle of linkage; وضعتها is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿قالت﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; رب is a munādā (one addressed) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿وضعتها﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; أنثى is an emphatic ḥāl (circumstantial), or an explanatory one; and the vocative clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿والله أعلم بما وضعت﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and أعلم is the khabar; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعلم; the clause ﴿وضعت﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما; and the clause ﴿والله أعلم بما وضعت﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.
﴿وليس الذكر كالأنثى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and الذكر is its noun; ﴿كالأنثى﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar of ليس, i.e. "the male is not like the female"; and ﴿الأنثى﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وإني سميتها مريم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿إني وضعتها﴾; إن is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause سميتها is its khabar; ﴿ها﴾ is the first object of سميت, and مريم is its second object.
﴿وإني أعيذها بك وذريتها من الشيطان الرجيم﴾: the wāw is also a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿إني سميتها﴾; إن is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أعيذها is the khabar of إن; ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; بك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعيذها; ذريتها is conjoined to the hāʾ, or a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); من الشيطان is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعيذها; and الرجيم is a naʿt (adjective) of الشيطان.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿فتقبلها ربها بقبول حسن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; تقبل is a past verb, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ربها is the fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقبلها; and حسن is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وأنبتها نباتا حسنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنبتها is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; نباتًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and حسنًا is a naʿt.
﴿وكفلها زكريا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كفل is a past verb; the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and زكريا is the second mafʿūl bihi, i.e. He made Zakariyyā her guardian and the one responsible for her welfare. [Translator's note: this parsing presupposes the reading with a doubled fāʾ, ﴿وكفَّلها﴾, with Allah as the latent fāʿil.]
﴿كلما دخل عليها زكريا المحراب﴾: ﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to ﴿وجد﴾ and containing the sense of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdarī-temporal; the clause ﴿دخل﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; and ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by annexation, the implied form being "every entering", with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "every time of entering". Or ﴿ما﴾ is a qualified indefinite meaning "time", the returning pronoun being omitted, the implied form being "every time he entered upon her in it"; the clause ﴿دخل﴾ is then in the position of the genitive as a naʿt of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿دخل﴾ is a past verb; ﴿عليها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿دخل﴾; ﴿زكريا﴾ is the fāʿil; and ﴿المحراب﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ).
﴿وجد عندها رزقا﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; عندها is an adverb attached to وجد; رزقًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and the conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قال يا مريم أنى لك هذا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. قال is a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he"; يا is a vocative particle; مريم is a munādā (one addressed), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; أنى is an interrogative noun, accusative as an adverb, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and هذا is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿قالت هو من عند الله﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; هو is a mubtadaʾ, and من عند الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿إن الله يرزق من يشاء بغير حساب﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause يرزق is the khabar; من is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; the clause يشاء has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; بغير حساب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرزق; and the clause ﴿إن الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it too falls within the scope of the saying.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿هنالك دعا زكريا ربه﴾: هنالك is a demonstrative of place in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place; the lām is for distance, and the kāf is for address; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) دعا; زكريا is the fāʿil (agent) of دعا, and ربه is the object; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قال رب هب لي من لدنك ذرية طيبة﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. قال is a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he", referring to Zakariyyā; رب is a munādā (one addressed) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; هب is a verb of supplication; لي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هب; من لدنك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ذرية is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and طيبة is a naʿt (adjective); and the vocative clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿إنك سميع الدعاء﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the kāf is its noun, and ﴿سميع الدعاء﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the clause is causal, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿فنادته الملائكة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; نادته الملائكة is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent).
﴿وهو قائم يصلي في المحراب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هو is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and قائم is its khabar (predicate); the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of the calling; the clause يصلي في المحراب is a second khabar of هو, or accusative as a ḥāl of the standing; and في المحراب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصلي.
﴿أن الله يبشرك بيحيى﴾: أن with what is in its khabar is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to نادته. [Translator's note: the source reads «أن وما في خبرها تأويل مصدر», evidently for «أن وما في حيزها في تأويل مصدر».]
﴿مصدقا بكلمة من الله﴾: مصدقًا is a ḥāl, and بكلمة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مصدقًا﴾.
﴿وسيدا وحصورا ونبيا من الصالحين﴾: the three words are conjoined to ﴿مصدقا﴾, and من الصالحين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نبيًّا﴾.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿قال رب أنى يكون لي غلام﴾: قال is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he", referring to Zakariyyā; رب is a munādā (one addressed) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; أنى is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون; لي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of يكون. Or كان is complete (tāmm), أنى is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and لي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. غلام is the noun of يكون, or its fāʿil. The clause ﴿قال رب أنى...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the vocative clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وقد بلغني الكبر﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; قد is a particle of confirmation; بلغني is a past verb, the nūn being the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الكبر is the fāʿil; and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿وامرأتي عاقر﴾: the wāw is also circumstantial; امرأتي is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and عاقر is the khabar; the clause is a ḥāl of the yāʾ in ﴿لي﴾, or a ḥāl of the yāʾ in ﴿بلغني﴾.
﴿قال كذلك الله يفعل ما يشاء﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being "Allah does what He wills of wonders, a doing like that doing"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يفعل ما يشاء﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the Name of Majesty; ما is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause يشاء has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ﴿ما﴾; and the clause ﴿كذلك الله يفعل...﴾ is the object of saying.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿قال رب اجعل لي آية﴾: قال is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is Zakariyyā; رب is a munādā (one addressed) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; اجعل is a verb of supplication, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "You"; لي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اجعل; آية is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the vocative clause and what follows it are the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause of saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قال آيتك ألا تكلم الناس﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. آيتك is a mubtadaʾ (subject); أن with what falls within its scope is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), the khabar (predicate); تكلم is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by أن; الناس is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is the object of saying.
﴿ثلاثة أيام إلا رمزا﴾: ثلاثة is an adverb attached to ﴿تكلم﴾; أيام is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); إلا is a particle of exception; and رمزًا is the excepted (mustathnā), accusative as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ).
﴿واذكر ربك كثيرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; اذكر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you"; ربك is the mafʿūl bihi; and كثيرًا is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar or of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "much remembrance" or "much time".
﴿وسبح بالعشي والإبكار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; سبح is conjoined to اذكر; بالعشي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سبح; and الإبكار is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿وإذ قالت الملائكة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the earlier ﴿إذ﴾ in His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ قالت امرأت عمران﴾; ﴿قالت الملائكة﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the verbal clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يا مريم إن الله اصطفاك﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and the whole clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وطهرك واصطفاك على نساء العالمين﴾: the two verbs are conjoined to اصطفاك; على نساء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اصطفاك; and العالمين is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿يا مريم اقنتي لربك﴾: يا is a vocative particle; مريم is a munādā (one addressed), a singular proper name; اقنتي is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اقنتي.
﴿واسجدي واركعي مع الراكعين﴾: the two imperative verbs are conjoined to اقنتي; مع is an adverb of place attached to اركعي; and الراكعين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:191-191.t:
﴿الذين يذكرون الله قياما وقعودا وعلى جنوبهم﴾: الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of أولي الألباب; the clause ﴿يذكرون الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿قيامًا وقعودًا﴾ are two ḥāls (circumstantials); على جنوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ويتفكرون في خلق السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to the one before it, falling within the scope of the ṣila; or: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ربنا ما خلقت هذا باطلا﴾: ربنا is a muḍāf (construct) munādā (one addressed), and a [verb of] saying must be implied, i.e. "saying: our Lord," so the clause is in the accusative as a ḥāl; ما is negating; خلقت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); هذا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); باطلًا is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in vain"; or a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "a vain creating"; or a ḥāl from هذا.
