﴿سبحانك فقنا عذاب النار﴾: سبحانك: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); it, together with its omitted verb, is a parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) clause with no grammatical position. فقنا: the fāʾ is conjunctive, for sequence, i.e. "we declare You transcendent, so protect us"; or it is the faṣīḥa, for the sense of an implied requital, i.e. "if You will our requital, then protect us." ﴿قِ﴾ is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ); ﴿نا﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عذاب النار﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:192-192.t:
﴿ربنا إنك من تدخل النار فقد أخزيته﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; ربنا is a muḍāf (construct) munādā (one addressed); إنك: إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the kāf is its noun (ism); من is a jussive-making conditional noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); تدخل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); النار is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), or a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); فقد: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because the answer is joined with قد; أخزيته is a verb, a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause joined with the fāʾ is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis; and the clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of إن.
﴿وما للظالمين من أنصار﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negating; للظالمين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; من is a connective (ṣila) preposition; أنصار is genitive (majrūr) by ﴿من﴾ in form, nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) in position.

muyesser-irab:193-193.t:
﴿ربنا إننا سمعنا مناديا ينادي للإيمان﴾: ربنا is a muḍāf (construct) munādā (one addressed); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿سمعنا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); مناديًا is the object of سمعنا; the clause ﴿ينادي﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa); للإيمان is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينادي﴾; and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿أن آمنوا بربكم فآمنا﴾: أن is maṣdariyya; آمنوا is an imperative verb; أن and what is in its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ينادي﴾. The clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. ﴿بربكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آمنوا; ﴿فآمنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for sequence and immediate succession (taʿqīb).
﴿ربنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وكفر عنا سيئاتنا﴾: the fāʾ in His saying ﴿فاغفر﴾ is conjunctive; لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اغفر﴾; ذنوبنا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿كفر﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿اغفر﴾; ﴿عنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفر﴾; سيئاتنا is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وتوفنا مع الأبرار﴾: conjoined to what preceded; توف is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; ﴿نا﴾ is its object; ﴿مع﴾ is an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الأبرار is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:194-194.t:
﴿ربنا وآتنا ما وعدتنا على رسلك﴾: speech conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what preceded; ربنا is a muḍāf (construct) munādā (one addressed); ﴿آتنا﴾ is conjoined to the preceding verbs of supplication; ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿وعدتنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿على رسلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وعدتنا﴾, and an omitted muḍāf must be implied, i.e. "upon the tongues of Your messengers"; or: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "sent down upon Your messengers."
﴿ولا تخزنا يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تخزنا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; ﴿نا﴾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; ﴿يوم القيامة﴾ is an adverb of time attached to ﴿تخزنا﴾.
﴿إنك لا تخلف الميعاد﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, giving the reason for their request; إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the kāf is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿لا تخلف الميعاد﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:195-195.t:
﴿فاستجاب لهم ربهم أني لا أضيع عمل عامل منكم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); استجاب is a past verb; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) استجاب; ربهم is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿فاستجاب لهم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. أني: أن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the yāʾ is its noun (ism); أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to استجاب, to make clear the cause; the clause ﴿لا أضيع﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; ﴿عمل عامل﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of عامل.
﴿من ذكر أو أنثى بعضكم من بعض﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿عامل﴾ after its being qualified, or a second adjective of ﴿عامل﴾; and it was said: a corresponding badal (badal muṭābiq, substitute) of ﴿منكم﴾; بعضكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من بعض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause ﴿بعضكم من بعض﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position, brought between His saying ﴿عَمَلَ عامِلٍ﴾ and that by which the work of the worker is detailed, namely His saying ﴿فالذين هاجَرُواْ﴾; or it is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عامل﴾, or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of ﴿عامل﴾.
﴿فالذين هاجروا وأخرجوا من ديارهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, for branching off (tafrīʿ); الذين is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿هاجروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فالذين هاجروا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿وأخرجوا﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿هاجروا﴾; ﴿من ديارهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخرجوا﴾.
﴿وأوذوا في سبيلي وقاتلوا وقتلوا﴾: the whole clause is conjoined, falling within the scope of the ṣila, with no grammatical position.
﴿لأكفرن عنهم سيئاتهم﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; ﴿أكفرن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its being attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the oath clause is the khabar of ﴿الذين﴾; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أكفرن﴾; سيئاتهم is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولأدخلنهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿لأدخلنهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لأكفرن﴾; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; جنات is accusative by removal of the preposition, or a second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾ is an adjective of جنات.
﴿ثوابا﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, conveying emphasis; and it was said: a ḥāl from جنات, or from the hāʾ in ﴿لأدخلنهم﴾.
﴿من عند الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿ثوابًا﴾. The Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿والله عنده حسن الثواب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ; عنده is an adverb attached to an omitted fronted khabar; ﴿حسن الثواب﴾ is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the Name of Majesty; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:196-196.t: ﴿لا يغرنك تقلب الذين كفروا في البلاد﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; لا is the prohibitive [lā] (nāhiya); ﴿يغرنك﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a jussive (majzūm) by لا; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); تقلب is the fāʿil (agent); الذين is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿في البلاد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقلب, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun).

muyesser-irab:197-197.t:
﴿متاع قليل ثم مأواهم جهنم﴾: متاع is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); قليل is an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ثم is a conjunction for delay (tarākhī); مأواهم is the mubtadaʾ, and جهنم the khabar.
﴿وبئس المهاد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); بئس: a past verb for expressing blame, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; المهاد is the fāʿil (agent) of بئس; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. Jahannam; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:198-198.t:
﴿لكن الذين اتقوا ربهم لهم جنات﴾: لكن is lightened, inoperative, for rectification (istidrāk); الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿اتقوا ربهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); جنات is a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين; and the clause ﴿لكن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها﴾: the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of جنات; ﴿من تحتها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; الأنهار is the fāʿil (agent); خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خالدين﴾.
﴿نزلا﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, or a ḥāl from جنات.
﴿من عند الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿نزلًا﴾. The Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وما عند الله خير للأبرار﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mubtadaʾ; ﴿عند الله﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar; ﴿للأبرار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خير﴾; and the clause ﴿وما عند الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:199-199.t:
﴿وإن من أهل الكتاب لمن يؤمن بالله﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿من أهل الكتاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿لمن﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and من is a relative noun, the postponed noun (ism) of إن; the clause ﴿يؤمن بالله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمن﴾. The clause ﴿وإن من أهل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما أنزل إليكم وما أنزل إليهم خاشعين لله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the Name of Majesty; the clause ﴿أنزل إليكم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿وما أنزل إليهم﴾ is likewise conjoined; خاشعين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿يؤمن﴾; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خاشعين.
﴿لا يشترون بآيات الله ثمنا قليلا﴾: the clause ﴿لا يشترون﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿بآيات الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يشترون﴾; ثمنًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); قليلًا is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿أولئك لهم أجرهم عند ربهم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; أجرهم is a postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿عند ربهم﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "being settled with their Lord"; and the clause is the khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾.
﴿إن الله سريع الحساب﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle; the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿سريع الحساب﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:200-200.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: resumptive speech, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is a munādā (one addressed) that is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ﴿ها﴾ is for alerting (tanbīh). الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾. ﴿آمنوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿اصبروا وصابروا ورابطوا﴾: verbs of supplication (afʿāl duʿāʾ). [Translator's note: so in the source; these are imperative verbs addressed by Allah to the believers, and «أفعال دعاء» appears to be carried over from the supplications of the preceding ayahs.]
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: likewise conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿لعلكم تفلحون﴾: لعل is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; the kāf is its noun (ism); the clause is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope (rajāʾ) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿ولقد نصركم الله ببدر﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realization; نصركم الله is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a delayed fāʿil (agent); ببدر is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نصركم; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأنتم أذلة﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl; أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and أذلة the khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فاتقوا الله لعلكم تشكرون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the Name of Majesty is a direct object; لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the kāf is its noun, and the clause تشكرون is its khabar; and the clause of hope is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿إذ تقول للمؤمنين﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) نصركم, or a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember", or a noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of an accusative as a second badal (substitute) from ﴿إذ غدوت﴾. The clause ﴿تقول﴾ is in the position of a genitive by annexation, and للمؤمنين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تقول.
﴿ألن يكفيكم أن يمدكم ربكم﴾: the interrogative clause is in the position of an accusative as maqūl al-qawl (the object of speech); the hamza is for interrogation of rebuke, as though they were like those despairing of victory; لن is an accusative-governing particle; يكفيكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative as direct object; أن is a maṣdar-forming, accusative-governing particle; يمدكم is an imperfect verb, accusative by it; أن and what falls in its scope are interpreted as a maṣdar, the fāʿil (agent) of يكفيكم; and ربكم is the agent of يمدكم.
﴿بثلاثة آلاف من الملائكة منزلين﴾: بثلاثة: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يمدكم; آلاف is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); من الملائكة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ثلاثة آلاف; and منزلين is a second adjective.

muyesser-irab:125-125.t:
﴿بلى إن تصبروا وتتقوا ويأتوكم من فورهم هذا﴾: بلى is an answering particle for cancelling the negation in His saying: ﴿ألن يكفيكم﴾; إن is conditional; تصبروا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); تتقوا is conjoined to تصبروا, and يأتوكم is also conjoined; من فورهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأتوكم; هذا is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of فوركم [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is فورهم], or a badal (substitute) from it; and the whole clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يمددكم ربكم بخمسة آلاف من الملائكة مسومين﴾: يمددكم is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ربكم is the agent; من الملائكة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of خمسة آلاف; and مسومين is a second adjective.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t:
﴿وما جعله الله إلا بشرى لكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negating; جعله الله is a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a delayed fāʿil (agent); إلا is a particle of restriction; بشرى is a second direct object if the making (جعل) here means "rendering", and if the making means "creating", then بشرى is parsed as an accusative noun, as an exception from the most general of causes, so it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بشرى.
﴿ولتطمئن قلوبكم به﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is for causation; تطمئن is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the implied ﴿أن﴾ with the imperfect verb after it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the lām of causation; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of an accusative, conjoined to بشرى, or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "He did this so that your hearts might be at rest"; قلوبكم is the agent of تطمئن; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تطمئن.
﴿وما النصر إلا من عند الله العزيز الحكيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negating; النصر is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction; من عند الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); العزيز الحكيم are two adjectives of Allah the Exalted; and the clause ﴿وما النصر...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t:
﴿ليقطع طرفا من الذين كفروا﴾: the lām is for causation; يقطع is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the implied ﴿أن﴾ with the imperfect verb after it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the lām of causation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نصركم in His saying: ﴿ولقد نصركم الله ببدر﴾, or attached to an omitted [verb], its implied form being "He reinforced you and gave you victory"; طرفًا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa); and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿أو يكبتهم فينقلبوا خائبين﴾: أو is a conjunction; يكبتهم is an imperfect verb conjoined to يقطع; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative as direct object; the fāʾ is a conjunction; ينقلبوا is conjoined to يكبتهم; and خائبين is a ḥāl (circumstantial), the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural.

muyesser-irab:128-128.t:
﴿ليس لك من الأمر شيء﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ليس is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ليس; من الأمر is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and شيء is the delayed noun of ليس.
﴿أو يتوب عليهم﴾: أو is a conjunction; يتوب is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after ﴿أو﴾, [together] interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined to شيء, i.e. "you have nothing of the matter, or of their repentance, or of their punishment". عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتوب.
﴿أو يعذبهم﴾: conjoined to يتوب.
﴿فإنهم ظالمون﴾: the fāʾ is for causation; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the hāʾ is its noun and ظالمون its khabar; and the clause is causal, with no grammatical position, because it stands as a resumptive clause.

muyesser-irab:129-129.t:
﴿ولله ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: the wāw is resumptive; لله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ما is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في السماوات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما في السماوات﴾. The clause ﴿ولله ما في...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يغفر لمن يشاء ويعذب من يشاء﴾: the verbal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), since it comes after a definite noun; لمن is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يغفر; يشاء is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is "he"; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause يعذب من يشاء is conjoined to it; and من is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿والله غفور رحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; غفور is its first khabar and رحيم its second khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:130-130.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تأكلوا الربا أضعافا مضاعفة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. لا is prohibitive; تأكلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); الربا is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أضعافًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and مضاعفة is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿واتقوا الله لعلكم تفلحون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; the Name of Majesty is its object; لعل [is an abrogating particle, the kāf being] its noun [Translator's note: the source reads «ولعل اسمها», with words evidently missing]; the clause تفلحون is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:131-131.t: ﴿واتقوا النار التي أعدت للكافرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is conjoined to what precedes; النار is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); التي is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as an adjective (ṣifa); the clause أعدت is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and للكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعدت.

muyesser-irab:132-132.t: ﴿وأطيعوا الله والرسول لعلكم ترحمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أطيعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الرسول is conjoined to the Name of Majesty; لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and the kāf its noun; ترحمون is an imperfect verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of لعل; and the clause of hope is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

muyesser-irab:133-133.t:
﴿وسارعوا إلى مغفرة من ربكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; سارعوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); إلى مغفرة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) سارعوا; and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of مغفرة.
﴿وجنة عرضها السماوات والأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جنة is conjoined to مغفرة; عرضها is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and السماوات the khabar (predicate); الأرض is conjoined to السماوات; and the nominal clause is an adjective of جنة.
﴿أعدت للمتقين﴾: the verbal clause is also an adjective of جنة; أعدت is a past verb, passive (literally: built for that whose agent is not named), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "it" (هي); and للمتقين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعدت.

muyesser-irab:134-134.t:
﴿الذين ينفقون في السراء والضراء﴾: the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective) of المتقين; the clause ينفقون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; في السراء is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون; and الضراء is conjoined to السراء.
﴿والكاظمين الغيظ والعافين عن الناس﴾: conjoined to المتقين; الغيظ is the object of the active participle الكاظمين; العافين is also conjoined; and عن الناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to العافين.
﴿والله يحب المحسنين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); يحب is an imperfect verb; المحسنين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يحب المحسنين﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿والله يحب المحسنين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ذلك من أنباء الغيب﴾: ذلك is a demonstrative, a mubtadaʾ (subject); من أنباء الغيب is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿نوحيه إليك﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is "We"; the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) نوحيه; and the clause is circumstantial (ḥāl), or likewise resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وما كنت لديهم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it resumptive with no grammatical position; ما is negative; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; the tāʾ is its noun; and لديهم is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar of كان, i.e. "present with them".
﴿إذ يلقون أقلامهم﴾: إذ is an adverb of past time, entering upon the imperfect to narrate a past state, attached to what لديهم is attached to, i.e. attached to the omitted khabar; the clause يلقون is in the position of the genitive by annexation; and أقلامهم is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أيهم يكفل مريم﴾: the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with a verb implied, i.e. "asking one another"; أي is a mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; and the clause يكفل مريم is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿وما كنت لديهم إذ يختصمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negative; ﴿كنت﴾: كان is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is the noun of كان; لديهم is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar of كان; إذ is an adverb of past time attached to the omitted khabar; and the clause يختصمون is in the position of the genitive by annexation.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿إذ قالت الملائكة﴾: إذ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember"; ﴿قالت الملائكة﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause ﴿قالت الملائكة﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; and the clause ﴿إذ قالت...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يا مريم﴾: يا is a vocative particle, and مريم is a munādā (one addressed), a singular proper name.
﴿إن الله يبشرك﴾: the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause يبشرك is its khabar (predicate).
﴿بكلمة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يبشرك.
﴿منه﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of كلمة.
﴿اسمه المسيح عيسى ابن مريم﴾: اسمه is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and المسيح is the khabar; the clause is a second naʿt of كلمة; عيسى is a badal (substitute) for المسيح; and ابن مريم is a badal or a naʿt.
﴿وجيها في الدنيا والآخرة ومن المقربين﴾: وجيهًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿كلمة﴾; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿وجيهًا﴾, so they are in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿ويكلم الناس في المهد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; يكلم is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; the clause is conjoined to ﴿وجيهًا﴾, so it too is a ḥāl (circumstantial); الناس is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and في المهد is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of ﴿يكلم﴾.
﴿وكهلا ومن الصالحين﴾: conjoined to His saying ﴿في المهد﴾; and من الصالحين is conjoined to ﴿وجيهًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿قالت رب أنى يكون لي ولد﴾: قالت is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); رب is a munādā (one addressed) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; أنى is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون; لي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of يكون. Or كان is complete (tāmm), أنى is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and لي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ولد is the noun of يكون, or its fāʿil. The clause ﴿قالت رب...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the vocative clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ولم يمسسني بشر﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; يمسسني is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لم, the nūn being the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بشر is the fāʿil; and the clause is a ḥāl.
﴿قال كذلك الله يخلق ما يشاء﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he". ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "Allah creates what He wills, a creating like that creating"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿يخلق ما يشاء﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative ﴿ما﴾; and the clause ﴿كذلك الله يخلق...﴾ is the object of saying.
﴿إذا قضى أمرا﴾: إذا is a future adverb; the clause قضى is in the position of the genitive by annexation; and أمرًا is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فإنما يقول له كن فيكون﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis of إذا; the clause إنما يقول has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; له is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يقول; كن is a complete (tāmm) imperative verb, and the clause is the object of saying; the fāʾ is resumptive; يكون is a complete imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma, and the fāʿil is "it"; the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "so it is"; and the clause ﴿فإنما يقول...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿ويعلمه الكتاب والحكمة والتوراة والإنجيل﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it resumptive with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction. يعلمه is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi; and what follows it is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿ورسولا إلى بني إسرائيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; رسولًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "and He will make him a messenger". It has also been said: رسولًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial), as though it were conjoined to يعلمه in meaning. إلى بني إسرائيل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رسولًا﴾.
﴿أني قد جئتكم بآية من ربكم﴾: أن with what falls within its scope is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "with [the message] that I have come to you", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿رسولًا﴾. It has also been said: the bāʾ is of accompaniment, and together with what it governs it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. The clause ﴿قد جئتكم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; بآية is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جئتكم; and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of آية.
﴿أني أخلق لكم من الطين كهيئة الطير﴾: أن with what falls within its scope is to be interpreted as a maṣdar, a badal (substitute) for آية; or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it is". The clause أخلق is the khabar of إن; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أخلق﴾, the lām being causal, i.e. "for your sake"; من الطين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أخلق﴾. ﴿كهيئة﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "something like the form of a bird"; هيئة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and الطير is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: the source writes «خبر إن», evidently for أنّ.]
﴿فأنفخ فيه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أنفخ is conjoined to أخلق; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنفخ.
﴿فيكون طيرا بإذن الله﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; يكون is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb conjoined to أخلق; طيرًا is the khabar of يكون, and its noun is latent (mustatir); and بإذن الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكون.
﴿وأبرئ الأكمه والأبرص﴾: conjoined to أخلق, and الأكمه is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وأحيي الموتى بإذن الله﴾: also conjoined to what precedes, and بإذن الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحيي.
﴿وأنبئكم بما تأكلون﴾: also conjoined; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أنبئكم, standing in for the two objects; and the clause تأكلون has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وما تدخرون في بيوتكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is conjoined to the earlier ﴿ما﴾; the clause تدخرون has no grammatical position; and في بيوتكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تدخرون.
﴿إن في ذلك لآية لكم إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); في ذلك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آية is its postponed noun; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of آية; and the clause of إن with what falls within its scope is within the scope of the saying; or it is the speech of Allah the Exalted, and so resumptive with no grammatical position. إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is a defective past verb in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun, and مؤمنين is its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the implied form being "if you are believers, you will benefit from this sign"; and the conditional clause ﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿ومصدقا لما بين يدي من التوراة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; مصدقًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of an omitted verb, i.e. "and I have come to you confirming", or it is conjoined to the position of ﴿بآية﴾. لما: the lām is a preposition, and ما is a relative noun in the genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مصدقًا﴾; بين is an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. يدي is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is dual, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and من التوراة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ولأحل لكم بعض الذي حرم عليكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); أحل is an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by أن optionally implied after the causal lām; the lām and what it governs are attached to an implied جئتكم, ولأحل being a statement of reason; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحل; بعض is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الذي is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause حرم عليكم has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿وجئتكم بآية من ربكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause جئتكم is conjoined to the earlier جئتكم, repeated for emphasis; بآية is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, the bāʾ being of accompaniment, the meaning being: "I am a messenger to you, while I am accompanied by my coming". Or it is attached to جئتكم. من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of آية.
﴿فاتقوا الله وأطيعون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ implying an omitted condition); اتقوا is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أطيعون is conjoined to اتقوا, and the yāʾ of the first person has been dropped out of regard for the verse-endings.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿إن الله ربي وربكم فاعبدوه﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna); the Name of Majesty is its noun, and ربي is its khabar (predicate); ربكم is conjoined to ربي. فاعبدوه: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ implying an omitted condition), i.e. "if you wish for a good final destination, then worship Him"; اعبدوه is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause اعبدوه has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿هذا صراط مستقيم﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. هذا is a mubtadaʾ (subject), صراط is the khabar, and مستقيم is a naʿt (adjective) of صراط.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿فلما أحس عيسى منهم الكفر﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being "so they disbelieved him"; or the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it resumptive with no grammatical position. لما is an adverb of time ("when"), or a linking particle; the clause ﴿أحس عيسى...﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it, or has no grammatical position if [لما] is parsed as linking. أحس is a past verb; عيسى is the fāʿil (agent); منهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحس; and الكفر is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or [منهم] is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكفر, i.e. "it issuing from them".
﴿قال من أنصاري إلى الله﴾: the clause قال has no [grammatical] position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, namely لما; من is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and أنصاري is its khabar (predicate); and إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl of the yāʾ in أنصاري. It has also been said: the preposition and its genitive noun are a naʿt (adjective) of أنصاري, which carries the sense of annexation.
﴿قال الحواريون نحن أنصار الله﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. قال الحواريون is a verb and its fāʿil; and the clause ﴿نحن أنصار الله﴾, made up of mubtadaʾ and khabar, is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿آمنا بالله﴾: آمنا is a verb and its fāʿil; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمنا; and the clause is a second khabar of نحن.
﴿واشهد بأنا مسلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; اشهد is an imperative verb. بأنا: the bāʾ is a preposition; أن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and مسلمون is its khabar. The interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and what falls within its scope is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿اشهد﴾; and the clause ﴿واشهد بأنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ربنا آمنا بما أنزلت﴾: ربنا is a munādā (one addressed) that is muḍāf; the clause آمنا is a third khabar (predicate) of نحن; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنا; and the clause أنزلت has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿واتبعنا الرسول﴾: conjoined to the clause آمنا, and الرسول is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ implying an omitted condition), i.e. "if the matter is as stated, then write us down", or it is resumptive; مع is an adverb of place attached to اكتبنا, and الشاهدين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). If the fāʾ is taken as resumptive, the clause ﴿فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿ومكروا ومكر الله والله خير الماكرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; مكروا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); مكر الله is conjoined to مكروا. والله: the wāw is circumstantial; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and خير الماكرين is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause ﴿ومكروا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿إذ قال الله يا عيسى﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ومكر الله﴾ or to ﴿خير الماكرين﴾; or it is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember", i.e. "remember when Allah said: O ʿĪsā". The clause ﴿قال الله﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; يا is a vocative particle; and عيسى is a munādā (one addressed), a singular proper name, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif.
﴿إني متوفيك ورافعك إلي﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (of the sisters of inna), the yāʾ is its noun, and متوفيك is its khabar (predicate), the kāf being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); رافعك is conjoined to متوفيك; and إلي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رافعك, because it is an active participle.
﴿ومطهرك من الذين كفروا﴾: مطهرك is conjoined to what precedes; من الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مطهرك; and the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وجاعل الذين اتبعوك فوق الذين كفروا﴾: جاعل is also conjoined; الذين is a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation; the clause اتبعوك is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; فوق is an adverb of place attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi of جاعل; الذين is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause كفروا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إلى يوم القيامة﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to جاعل, meaning: this making continues until the Day of Resurrection.
﴿ثم إلي مرجعكم﴾: ثم is a conjunction denoting delay; إلي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; and مرجعكم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فأحكم بينكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction denoting immediate succession; أحكم is a nominative imperfect verb; and بينكم is an adverb of place attached to أحكم.
﴿فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون﴾: فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحكم; the clause كنتم is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يختلفون; the clause تختلفون is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كنتم; and the whole clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿فأما الذين كفروا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; أما is a particle of condition and of detailing; الذين is a mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿فأعذبهم عذابا شديدا في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: the fāʾ connects the apodosis of أما; أعذبهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of الذين; عذابًا stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar); شديدًا is a naʿt (adjective); في الدنيا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second naʿt; and الآخرة is conjoined to الدنيا.
﴿وما لهم من ناصرين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, or resumptive; ما is negative; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar; من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; ناصرين is genitive by من in form and nominative in position, because it is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿وما لهم...﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāl), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:135-135.t:
﴿والذين إذا فعلوا فاحشة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; الذين is a relative noun conjoined to الذين in the previous verse; or: ﴿الذين﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is ﴿أولئك﴾; إذا is a future adverb; the clause فعلوا is in the position of a genitive by annexation; and فاحشة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أو ظلموا أنفسهم ذكروا الله﴾: أو is a conjunction; ظلموا is conjoined to فعلوا; أنفسهم is a direct object; and the clause ذكروا الله has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition.
﴿فاستغفروا لذنوبهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; استغفروا is conjoined to ذكروا, i.e. "they repented of them"; and لذنوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) استغفروا.
﴿ومن يغفر الذنوب إلا الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is interrogative, the sense of the interrogation here being negation, and it is in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause يغفر is the khabar; الذنوب is a direct object; إلا is a particle of restriction; and the Name of Majesty is a badal (substitute) from the pronoun in يغفر, i.e. from the latent (mustatir) agent; the clause ﴿ومن يغفر...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولم يصروا على ما فعلوا وهم يعلمون﴾: conjoined to استغفروا; لم is a jussivizing particle; يصروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; على ما فعلوا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يصروا; the clause فعلوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; وهم: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), هم is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is the khabar; and the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of ﴿يصروا﴾.

muyesser-irab:136-136.t:
﴿أولئك جزاؤهم مغفرة من ربهم﴾: أولئك is a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); جزاؤهم is a second mubtadaʾ; مغفرة is the khabar (predicate) of جزاؤهم; and the second mubtadaʾ with its khabar is the khabar of the demonstrative. Or: ﴿الذين﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and the clause is the khabar of the relative noun; من ربهم is an adjective (ṣifa) of مغفرة.
﴿وجنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; جنات is conjoined to مغفرة; the clause تجري من تحتها الأنهار is an adjective of جنات; خالدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين.
﴿ونعم أجر العاملين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; نعم is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; أجر العاملين is the fāʿil (agent) of نعم, being annexed to [a noun] bearing al-; and the one specifically praised (al-makhṣūṣ bil-madḥ) is omitted, its implied form being "excellent is the reward of the workers, that", meaning the forgiveness in the gardens. The clause ﴿ونعم أجر العاملين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:137-137.t:
﴿قد خلت من قبلكم سنن﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of realization; خلت is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; من قبلكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلت; and سنن is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فسيروا في الأرض﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; سيروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سيروا; and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of an implied, non-jussivizing condition.
﴿فانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; انظروا is conjoined to سيروا; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; كان عاقبة: كان is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb and عاقبة is its noun; المكذبين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the interrogative clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of انظروا.

muyesser-irab:138-138.t: ﴿هذا بيان للناس وهدى وموعظة للمتقين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; هذا is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and بيان its khabar (predicate); للناس is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بيان; هدى is conjoined to بيان, and likewise موعظة; and للمتقين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to موعظة, or to an omitted adjective of it.

muyesser-irab:139-139.t:
﴿ولا تهنوا ولا تحزنوا وأنتم الأعلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the statement is conjoined to what is understood from His saying: فسيروا; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; ﴿تهنوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; ﴿ولا تحزنوا﴾ is also conjoined; ﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ﴿أنتم﴾ is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الأعلون﴾ is its khabar (predicate), nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its noun and ﴿مؤمنين﴾ its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; and the conditional clause ﴿إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:140-140.t:
﴿إن يمسسكم قرح فقد مس القوم قرح مثله﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿يمسسكم﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿قرح﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of يمسسكم; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "then take example and console yourselves". ﴿فقد﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction and ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization; ﴿مس القوم﴾ is conjoined to the omitted apodosis; ﴿مس﴾ is a past verb, ﴿القوم﴾ a fronted direct object, ﴿قرح﴾ a delayed agent, and ﴿مثله﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of قرح; and the clause ﴿إن يمسسكم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وتلك الأيام نداولها بين الناس﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الأيام﴾ is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; the clause ﴿نداولها﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿ها﴾ is a direct object; and ﴿بين الناس﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نداولها﴾. Or: ﴿الأيام﴾ is the khabar of the demonstrative and the clause ﴿نداولها﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the governing element in it being the meaning of the demonstrative, i.e. "I point to them while they are being alternated". The clause ﴿وتلك الأيام...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وليعلم الله الذين آمنوا﴾: the wāw conjoins to the omitted [statement] that is explained by the cause, the implied form being "We did that so that they might take admonition"; وليعلم: the lām is for causation; ﴿يعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; the implied ﴿أن﴾ with the imperfect verb after it is interpreted as a maṣdar, genitive by the lām of causation; and the lām of causation with its genitive noun is attached to an implied verb, i.e. "We alternate them so that He may know"; the Name of Majesty is the agent; ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun, direct object; ﴿آمنوا﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويتخذ منكم شهداء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يتخذ﴾ is an imperfect verb conjoined to ﴿يعلم﴾; ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يتخذ﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿شهداء﴾; and ﴿شهداء﴾ is a direct object.
﴿والله لا يحب الظالمين﴾: the clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position; the wāw is parenthetical; the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ; and the clause ﴿لا يحب الظالمين﴾ is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:141-141.t:
﴿وليمحص الله الذين آمنوا﴾: the clause is conjoined to the preceding causes; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويمحق الكافرين﴾: conjoined to the preceding causes.

muyesser-irab:142-142.t:
﴿أم حسبتم أن تدخلوا الجنة﴾: ﴿أم﴾ is disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa), meaning "rather" together with the hamza of interrogation of rebuke and reproach; ﴿حسبتم﴾ is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿أن﴾ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of حسب; and ﴿الجنة﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition.
﴿ولما يعلم الله الذين جاهدوا منكم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿لما﴾ is jussivizing; ﴿يعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); the Name of Majesty is the agent; ﴿الذين﴾ is a relative noun, direct object; the clause ﴿جاهدوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿ويعلم الصابرين﴾: the wāw is of accompaniment (maʿiyya); ﴿يعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the wāw of accompaniment; أن with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. "and there is not yet knowledge of who strove and knowledge of who was patient"; the agent is "he"; ﴿الصابرين﴾ is a direct object; and the negation has preceded it.

muyesser-irab:143-143.t:
﴿ولقد كنتم تمنون الموت من قبل أن تلقوه﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization; ﴿كنتم﴾: the defective (nāqiṣ) كان, the tāʾ being its noun; the clause ﴿تمنون﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿الموت﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمنون﴾; ﴿أن تلقوه﴾: أن is a maṣdar-forming, accusative-governing particle; تلقوه is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ a direct object; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن﴾ and the verb ﴿تلقوه﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿ولقد كنتم تمنون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فقد رأيتموه وأنتم تنظرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; قد is a particle of realization; ﴿رأيتموه﴾ is a verb, its agent and its direct object, and the wāw is for lengthening the ḍamma; ﴿وأنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), أنتم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿تنظرون﴾ is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:144-144.t:
﴿وما محمد إلا رسول﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the statement after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿محمد﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of restriction; and ﴿رسول﴾ is the khabar (predicate).
﴿قد خلت من قبله الرسل﴾: the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رسول﴾; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realization; ﴿خلت﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; ﴿من قبله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلت﴾; and ﴿الرسل﴾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿أفإن مات أو قتل انقلبتم على أعقابكم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of rebuke; the fāʾ is for conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿مات﴾ is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿أو قتل﴾ is conjoined to ﴿مات﴾; ﴿انقلبتم﴾ is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and ﴿على أعقابكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ومن ينقلب على عقبيه فلن يضر الله شيئا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿من﴾ is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; ﴿ينقلب﴾ is the protasis; ﴿على عقبيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; the fāʾ links the apodosis; ﴿يضر﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿شيئًا﴾ is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause ﴿فلن يضر﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis with its apodosis is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of ﴿من﴾.
﴿وسيجزي الله الشاكرين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿يجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the Name of Majesty is the agent; ﴿الشاكرين﴾ is a direct object; and the clause ﴿وسيجزي الله الشاكرين﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
